n-m-h1-ineq-03.title: "Haddii a<b, markaas 1/a > 1/b" ma had iyo jeer run baa? Dhisidda tusaalayaal lid ku ah
n-m-h1-ineq-03.goal: Naftaada u dhis tusaalayaal lid ku ah si aad u hubiso goorta sheegasho guud ee sifada sinaan la'aanta ay run tahay, oo hel shuruudda sheegashadu ku qabato.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.material: Mina waxay tidhi, "Haddii a<b, markaas 1/a > 1/b. Haddii 2<5, markaas 1/2 > 1/5, haddii 3<7 na 1/3 > 1/7. Waxaan hubiyay dhowr, dhammaantood waa sax." (a iyo b waa tirooyin aan eber ahayn.)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.0: Kala saarista tusaalayaasha ku habboon sheegashada iyo kuwa ka soo horjeeda
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.1: Helidda waxa tusaalayaasha lid ku ah ay wadaagaan
n-m-h1-ineq-03.thinking.2: Soo koobidda shuruudda ay ku qabato
n-m-h1-ineq-03.prereq.0: Sifooyinka aasaasiga ah ee sinaan la'aanta
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.prompt: Samee tusaalayaal muujinaya sheegashada Mina inay khaldan tahay. Gali saddex lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan oo aan eber ahayn a, b oo a<b laakiin 1/a > 1/b aysan qabsoon. (Qiimaha saxda ah ugu badnaan 50)
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Naftaada tijaabi dhowr lammaane. Beddel calaamadaha a iyo b, xisaabi 1/a iyo 1/b, oo barbar dhig cabbirkooda.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg sifadee ayay tusaalayaasha Mina hubisay dhammaantood wadaagaan, oo hel lammaane aan sifadaas lahayn.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c1: a iyo b waa inay noqdaan tirooyin aan eber ahayn.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.ok.c3: Qiimayaasha saxda ah waa ugu badnaan 50.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c3: Isticmaal tirooyin dhan oo qiimahooda sax ah ugu badnaan 50.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.ok.c5: 1/a > 1/b ma qabsoona. Waa tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.fail.c5: Lammaanahan, 1/a > 1/b weli way qabataa, sidaas darteed ma aha tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s1.explain: Haddii a=−2 iyo b=5, markaas 1/a=−1/2 iyo 1/b=1/5, sidaas darteed 1/a < 1/b. Dhammaan tusaalayaasha lid ku ah, a wuu taban yahay b-na wuu togan yahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.prompt: Dooro shuruudda saxda ah ee 1/a > 1/b ay tahay inay qabato marka a<b iyo a, b aan eber ahayn.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Barbar dhig calaamadaha a iyo b ee tusaalayaasha lid ku ah ee aad samaysay tallaabadii hore iyo tusaalayaasha Mina hubisay.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, samee lammaane tiro ah oo ku habboon oo barbar dhig 1/a iyo 1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.o.a: Ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah a iyo b waa togan yahay
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.a: Xitaa haddii mid togan yahay, sida a=−2, b=5, sheegashadu way fashilantaa.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.o.b: Tirada weyn b waa togan tahay
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.b: Haddii b=5 iyo a=−2, waa tusaale lid ku ah. b inuu togan yahay ma ku filna.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.o.c: Labada a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.r.c: Waxaa jira tusaale lid ku ah oo tiro dhan ah (−2, 5). Dhibaatadu waa calaamadda, ma aha nooca tirada.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.o.d: a iyo b waxay leeyihiin isla calaamad
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s2.explain: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab) iyo b−a>0, sidaas darteed haddii ab>0 waa togan yahay 1/a>1/b. Haddii ab<0 waa taban yahay sheegashaduna way fashilantaa.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.prompt: Qor 1/a − 1/b sida hal jajab, oo isticmaal waxa go'aamiya calaamaddiisa si aad u sharaxdo sababta jawaabta tallaabada 2 ay sax u tahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.0: Hel hooseeye guud oo qor 1/a − 1/b sida hal jajab.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ku xidh waxa calaamadaha korreeyaha iyo hooseeyaha mid walba ku xidhan yahay shuruudda a<b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.placeholder: tus., 1/a − 1/b = ..., iyo b−a waa ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma si sax ah u qortay jajabka la isku daray?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah korreeyuhu had iyo jeer waa togan yahay?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma gabagabeysay in natiijadu ku xidhan tahay calaamadda ab?
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.0: 1/a − 1/b = (b−a)/(ab). Maadaama a<b, b−a waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed calaamadda waxaa go'aamiya ab. Haddii ab>0, markaas 1/a>1/b, haddii ab<0, markaas 1/a<1/b.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.1: Isku darista waxay siinaysaa (b−a)/(ab). Korreeyaha b−a waa togan yahay, sidaas darteed 1/a − 1/b > 0 marka ab uu togan yahay oo keliya, taasi waa, marka a iyo b ay leeyihiin isla calaamad.
n-m-h1-ineq-03.s.s3.model.2: Korreeyaha b−a waa togan yahay sababtoo ah a<b. Sidaas darteed natiijadu waxay ku xidhan tahay haddii wax-soo-saarka a iyo b uu yahay togan ama taban.

n-m-h1-comb-05.title: Maxaan u baahanahay inaan ogaano si aan u go'aamino imisa hab ayaa kubbado loogu qaybin karaa sanduuqyo?
n-m-h1-comb-05.topic: Tirinta: go'aaminta waxa laga dhigayo kala duwan dhibaatada
n-m-h1-comb-05.goal: Dhibaatada tirinta, aqoonso macluumaadka go'aaminaya haddii natiijooyin isku mid ah loo tixgeliyo hal (haddii shayada la kala saaro, haddii sanduuqyo madhan la oggol yahay), oo xaqiiji in tirintu is beddesho macluumaadkaas.
n-m-h1-comb-05.material: Mina waxay weydiisaa, "Imisa hab ayaa 3 kubbadood loogu qaybin karaa 2 sanduuq?", saaxiibadeedna waxay bixiyaan jawaabo kala duwan. Taasi waa sababtoo ah dhibaatadu waxay ka maqan tahay macluumaad qaar.
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.0: Aqoonso macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo gaaro hal jawaab
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.1: Ogow in tirintu is beddesho iyadoo ku xidhan halbeegga lagu tixgelinayo shayada inay isku mid yihiin
n-m-h1-comb-05.thinking.2: Sharax sida tirintu is beddesho marka shuruud is beddesho
n-m-h1-comb-05.prereq.0: Liis gareynta kiisaska garaaf geed ama shax
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro wax kasta oo aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u gaarto hal jawaab dhibaatadan.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.0: Barbar dhig imisa natiijo oo kala duwan ayuu u eg yahay habaynta "3 kubbadood hal sanduuq ah, 0 kan kale" marka sanduuqyada la kala saaro iyo marka aan la kala saarin.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.hint.1: Beddel qaybaha macluumaadka mid mid, hubi haddii tirinta aad si toos ah u hesho is beddesho, oo hel macluumaadka aan beddelin.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.a: Haddii labada sanduuq la kala saaro (haddii sanduuqyada la tiriyo)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.b: Maaddadu tirinta ma saameyso. Haddii shayada la kala saaro waa macluumaadka beddela tirinta.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.c: Haddii 3-da kubbadood la kala saaro (haddii ay midabo kala duwan leeyihiin)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.o.d: Haddii sanduuq la oggol yahay inuu madhan yahay
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.r.e: Haddii midabka gudaha sanduuq uu u adeegayo hab lagu kala saaro horeyba waxaa looga dhigay haddii sanduuqyada la kala saaro. Macluumaadkan keligiis ma go'aamin karo tirinta.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s1.explain: Saddex shay ayaa la go'aamin karaa. Haddii sanduuqyada iyo kubbadaha la kala saaro waxay go'aamisaa haddii natiijooyin isla qaab ah loo tixgeliyo hal ama laba, haddii sanduuqyo madhan la oggol yahayna waxay beddelaysaa musharraxiinta laftooda. Maaddada iyo midabka gudaha tirinta ma saameeyaan.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.prompt: 3-da kubbadood dhammaantood way isku eg yihiin, labada sanduuq waxay leeyihiin tirooyin kala duwan sidaas darteed waa la kala saaray, oo sanduuqyo madhan la oggol yahay. Imisa hab ayaa jira?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.0: Kordhi tirada kubbadaha sanduuqa 1 laga bilaabo 0 mid mid, oo shax ku qor imisa ayaa gala sanduuqa 2.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi in maadaama kubbadaha dhammaantood isku mid yihiin, habaynta sanduuq uu qaato tiro kubbado isku mid ah loo tirin karo hal.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.a: Taasi waa tirinta marka sanduuqyada aan la kala saarin. Sanduuqyo tirooyin kala duwan leh, (3, 0) iyo (0, 3) waa natiijooyin kala duwan.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay tirisaa kiisaska leh 1, 2, ama 3 kubbadood sanduuqa 1 oo keliya. Kiiska leh 0 kubbadood sanduuqa 1 waa maqan yahay.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.r.d: Taasi waa tirinta marka kubbadaha la kala saaro. Kubbadaha dhibaatadan dhammaantood way isku mid yihiin.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s2.explain: Marka loo kala qaybiyo kiisaska sanduuqa 1 uu leeyahay 0, 1, 2, 3 kubbadood, inta hadhay waxay gashaa sanduuqa 2, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 4 hab. (Tusaale ahaan, 0 sanduuqa 1 macnaheedu waa 3 sanduuqa 2, iyo 3 sanduuqa 1 macnaheedu waa 0 sanduuqa 2, kuwaas oo ah natiijooyin kala duwan.)
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.prompt: Haddii 3-da kubbadood ay midabo kala duwan leeyihiin oo la kala saaray (sanduuqyada weli waa la kala saaray oo sanduuqyo madhan waa la oggol yahay), imisa hab ayaa jira? Sidoo kale sharax sida ay ula xiriirto 4-tii hab ee hore.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.0: Magacyo u bixi kubbadaha (casaan, buluug, huruud) oo qor, mid mid, go'aanka sanduuqa kubbad kasta gasho.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.hint.1: 4-tii hab ee hore, qor habaynta (2 sanduuqa 1, 1 sanduuqa 2) adigoo isticmaalaya kubbadaha la magacaabay, oo tiri imisa hab ayay tahay.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.placeholder: tus. Haddii kubbadaha la kala saaro, ...
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Marka kubbadaha la kala saaro, ma qortay imisa sanduuq ayaa hal kubbad gali karto?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma xisaabisay imisa hab ayaa natiijo sida (2, 1) ee 4-tii hab ee hore u kala qaybsantaa marka kubbadaha la kala saaro?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa sababta tirintu u kordhayso?
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.0: Haddii kubbadaha la kala saaro, kubbad kasta waxay leedahay 2 sanduuq oo ay gali karto, 3-da kubbadoodna waxaa la go'aamiyaa isku xigta, sidaas darteed 2×2×2=8 hab. Kubbado isku mid ah, (3, 0) waa 1 hab, laakiin marka kubbadaha la kala saaro, (2, 1) wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa 3 hab, sidaas darteed 1+3+3+1=8.
n-m-h1-comb-05.s.s3.model.1: Kubbad kasta waxay leedahay laba doorasho, sanduuqa 1 ama sanduuqa 2, sidaas darteed 2^3=8 hab. 4-ta hab ee kubbado isku mid ah waxay u kala qaybsamaan 1, 3, 3, 1 hab marka kubbadaha la kala saaro, kuwaasna waxay isku darmaan 8.

n-m-h1-comb-06.title: U sharaxidda walaalkayga yar sida loo habeeyo xarfaha BANANA
n-m-h1-comb-06.topic: Kala horreyn: sharaxaadda sababta aan u qaybino kala horreynta shayada isku midka ah
n-m-h1-comb-06.goal: Fahan sababta aan u qaybino qaacidada kala horreynta shayada isku midka ah, oo dib u qor xal kaliya muujinaya qaacidada erayo ay fahmi karto walaal yar oo dugsiga dhexe ah.
n-m-h1-comb-06.material: Hyunsu wuxuu u xalliyay "tirada hababka loo habeeyo lixda xaraf ee BANANA saf" sidan: 6! ÷ (3!×2!) = 720 ÷ 12 = 60 hab. Walaalkiis yar, arday sannadka labaad ee dugsiga dhexe oo arkay xalkan, wuxuu yidhi, "Ma fahmin sababta aan u qaybino, ama sababta ay u tahay 3! iyo 2!." (BANANA wuxuu leeyahay 1 B, 3 A, iyo 2 N.)
n-m-h1-comb-06.thinking.0: Akhri waxa qayb kasta oo tibaaxda ah tiriso
n-m-h1-comb-06.thinking.1: Dib u qor xal si uu ugu habboonaado dhagaystayaasha
n-m-h1-comb-06.thinking.2: Isla habkaas ku dabaq xarfo kale
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir imisa hab ayaa jira oo loo habeeyo xarfaha marka lagu kala saaro tirooyin, sida A₁A₂A₃.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.hint.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya xarfo tiro leh, samee dhowr habayn oo u eg BANANA.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.a: Tirada habaynta ka dib marka xarfaha isku midka ah ee 6-da xaraf laga saaray
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.a: 6! ma laha tallaabo ka saarista xarfaha isku midka ah. 6! waa tirada aad hesho marka lixdaba loo tixgeliyo kuwo kala duwan.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.b: Tirada habaynta ee lagu tiriyay adigoo saddexda A iyo labada N u tixgelinaya xarfo la kala saari karo
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.c: Tirada tirisa habaynta qaabkoodu ka duwan yahay BANANA oo keliya
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.c: Tirada habaynta leh qaabab kala duwan waa qiimaha aan rabno (60). 6! sidoo kale si gooni ah ayay u tirisaa habaynta u eg isku mid.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.o.d: Tirada hababka loo doorto 3 ka mid ah 6-da xaraf
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.r.d: Tani ma aha doorasho; waa habayn dhammaan 6-da saf ah.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s1.explain: Haddii aan u tixgelino lix xaraf oo kala duwan A₁, A₂, A₃, N₁, N₂, B, sidaan saf ugu dhigno waxay siinaysaa 6!=720 hab. Laakiin dhab ahaan A-yada ma kala saari karaan midba midka kale, ama N-yada, sidaas darteed isla qaab ayaa dhowr jeer la tiriyay.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor xalka Hyunsu 3 ilaa 4 jumladood si walaalkiis yar u fahmo. Sharax sababta tibaaxdu sidaas u soo baxdo, oo sii hal tusaale.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.hint.0: Si loo fahamsiiyo qof aan ogayn tibaaxda, marka hore sheeg qiimaynta "haddii aan dhammaan xarfaha u tixgelino kuwo kala duwan".
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qor hal habayn oo BANANA ah oo tirooyin ku leh saddexda A, kadibna qor habaynta noqota isla erayga marka tirooyinka la is badalo.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Marka aad isticmaashay erayo walaalkaa aan aqoon (kala horreyn, factorial), ma sharaxday?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay tusaale muujinaya in is badalidda xarfaha isku midka ah ay siinayso isla erayga?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay sababta qaybiyayaashu u yihiin 3! iyo 2!?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.0: Waxaa jira saddex A, sidaas darteed bilowga waxaan iska yeelaynaa in A-yadu yihiin xarfo kala duwan oo waxaan tirinaa 6! hab. Laakiin is badalidda A-yada waxay siinaysaa isla erayga. Waxaa jira 3!=6 hab oo loo is badalo meelaha saddexda A, sidaas darteed eray kasta waxaa la tiriyay 6 jeer. Taasi waa sababta aan ugu qaybino 3!, N-yadana waxaan ku qaybinaa 2! sabab isku mid ah.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.1: Haddii aan midab ku sii daro saddexda A ee BANANA, sida A casaan, A buluug, A huruud, dhammaantood waxay noqdaan xarfo kala duwan oo waxaan tirinaa 6! hab. Laakiin haddii aan midabada tirtirno, habaynta A-yada is badalay waxay noqdaan isla erayga. Waxaa jira 3!=6 hab oo loo is badalo A-yada, sidaas darteed kooxo ka kooban 6 habayn waa isla erayga, taasina waa sababta aan ugu qaybino 3!. N-yadu waxay yimaadaan kooxo 2 ah, sidaas darteed waxaan ku qaybinaa 2!.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s2.model.2: Haddii aan xarfaha tirooyin siino oo aan u tixgelino kuwo kala duwan, waxaa jira 6!=720 hab, laakiin marka aan tirooyinka ka saarno eray kasta waa la tiriyay 12 jeer. Sidaas darteed waxaan 720 ku qaybinaa 12 si aan u helno 60 hab. 12 waa wax-soo-saarka 3!, is badalidda A-yada, iyo 2!, is badalidda N-yada.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya isla habkaas, imisa hab ayaa jira oo loo habeeyo shanta xaraf ee AABBC saf?
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor xarfaha eraygan ku jira ee dib loo tiriyay iyo imisa jeer mid kasta la soo celiyay.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ku waafaji waxa loo sameeyay BANANA xarfaha isku midka ah ee eraygan.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.a: Taasi waa tirada marka A iyo B oo dhan loo tixgeliyo xarfo kala duwan. Ma muujinayso in is badalidda xarfaha isku midka ah ay siinayso isla erayga.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.b: A-yada oo keliya ayaa lagu qaybiyay 2! B-yadana lama qaybin. B-yada, oo sidoo kale ah laba xaraf oo isku mid ah, waa in lagu qaybiyaa sabab isku mid ah.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.r.c: Taasi waa qiimaha 5×4. Ma tirisaa tirada hababka loo habeeyo xarfaha.
n-m-h1-comb-06.s.s3.explain: Haddii shanta xaraf dhammaantood loo tixgeliyo kuwo kala duwan, waxaa jira 5!=120 hab, eray kastana waxaa dib loo tiriyay 2! hab oo loogu is badalo A-yada iyo 2! hab oo loogu is badalo B-yada, sidaas darteed 5!÷(2!×2!)=120÷4=30 hab.

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.prompt: Saddexda jeerba, waxaa jiray lammaanno badan oo wadarkoodu aan lammaan ahayn (O>E). Sidee ayaan u xukumi karnaa sheegashada Minho iyo natiijadan?
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir haddii jebinta sheegashada Minho ay u baahan tahay hal tusaale ama dhammaan kiisaska.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii sheegashada cusub "n kasta waxaa jira wadarro badan oo aan lammaan ahayn" ay ku dhisantahay saddex tusaale.

n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.b: Tirooyinka lambarrada aan lammaan ahayn iyo lammaanka ahi waa ku dhawaad isku mid, sidaas darteed waxaan farqigan ka dhigi karnaa khalad oo odhan karnaa sheegashada Minho (O=E) waa sax.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.b: Sheegashada Minho waa in O iyo E ay "siman yihiin". Haddii O iyo E ee aad si toos ah u tiriday ay kala duwan yihiin, sheegashadu ma aha sax n kaas. Ma badbaadin kartid sheegashada adigoo farqiga dib ugu magacaabaya "khalad".
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.c: Saddexda qiime ee aan dooray, O≠E, sidaas darteed waa tusaalayaal lid ku ah sheegashada Minho (O=E), laakiin si loo yiraahdo n kasta waxaa jira wadarro badan oo aan lammaan ahayn, waa in si gooni gooni ah loo muujiyaa adigoo isticmaalaya xaraf.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.o.d: Marka n weynaado, farqiga O−E ee u dhexeeya O iyo E wuu yaraadaa wuxuuna ugu dambayn noqdaa O=E.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.r.d: n=4, 6, 8, O−E waa 2, 3, 4, taas oo runtii kordhaysa. Ma sheegi kartid dhowr tusaale waxa dhaca marka n weynaado.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s2.explain: Maadaama sheegashadu tahay guud (dhammaan n), hal tusaale oo lid ku ah ayaa muujin kara in sheegashadu khalad tahay. Dhinaca kale, sheegashada cusub "n kasta waxaa jira wadarro badan oo aan lammaan ahayn" lagama caddayn karo dhowr tusaale, sidaas darteed waa in lagu muujiyaa xaraf.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.prompt: Marka n=2k (k waa lambar dabiici ah), waxaa jira k lambar oo aan lammaan ahayn iyo k lambar oo lammaan ah. Ku muuji tirada O ee lammaannada wadarkoodu aan lammaan ahayn iyo tirada E ee lammaannada wadarkoodu lammaan yahay marka loo eego k, hel O−E, oo muuji in ay jiraan wadarro badan oo aan lammaan ahayn.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore qor lammaanka/aan lammaan ahayn ee labada lambar ee la doortay ay tahay inay noqdaan si wadarku u noqdo aan lammaan ahayn.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.hint.1: Ku muuji O iyo E marka loo eego k, fududee farqigooda, oo hubi calaamadiisa.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma tiri sababta dooridda hal lambar oo aan lammaan ahayn iyo hal lammaan ah ay u siinayso O?
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma u kala qaybisay E labada kiis ee dooridda laba isku nooc ah oo isku daray?
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma tiri in maadaama k uu yahay lambar dabiici ah, O−E had iyo jeer uu yahay mid togan?
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.0: Si wadarku u noqdo aan lammaan ahayn waa inaan doorano hal lambar oo aan lammaan ahayn iyo hal lammaan ah, sidaas darteed O=k×k=k². Si wadarku u noqdo lammaan waxaan dooranaa laba aan lammaan ahayn ama laba lammaan ah, sidaas darteed E=C(k,2)+C(k,2)=k(k−1). O−E=k²−k(k−1)=k, maadaama k uu yahay lambar dabiici ah had iyo jeer waa mid togan, sidaas darteed waxaa jira wadarro badan oo aan lammaan ahayn.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.1: O waa k×k=k² hab, oo doorta mid ka mid ah k lambar oo aan lammaan ahayn iyo mid ka mid ah k lambar oo lammaan ah. E waa k(k−1) hab, wadarka k(k−1)/2 hab ee dooridda laba aan lammaan ahayn iyo k(k−1)/2 hab ee dooridda laba lammaan ah. Farqiga O−E=k>0, sidaas darteed waxaa jira k wadar oo aan lammaan ahayn oo dheeraad ah.
n-m-h1-comb-08.s.s3.model.2: O waa k×k=k² hab, oo doorta mid ka mid ah k lambar oo aan lammaan ahayn iyo mid ka mid ah k lambar oo lammaan ah, E-na waa k(k−1) hab. Sidaas darteed O had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay E k.

Shuruudaha hoose dhexdooda, wuxuu rabaa inuu doorto kuwa saaxiibkiisa u oggolaanaya inuu sawiro isla goobool si gaar ah. (Goobool waa qaab leh hal udub-dhexaad bar iyo gacan-qaad togan.)

n-m-h1-geo-09.material: Diyaarada isku-duubyada waxaa ku yaal qayb xariiq ah AB oo isku xidhaysa labada bar A(0,0) iyo B(4,3). Xariiqda AB (ma aha qaybta) waa 3x−4y=0. (Akhri √13 sida "xidid 13" iyo √50 sida "xidid 50.")
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay masaafada ugu gaaban laga bilaabo barta P(7,1) ilaa bar qaybta AB ku taal?

n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hel labadaba masaafada ilaa xariiqda iyo masaafooyinka ilaa labada dhammaad, oo barbar dhig.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa qiimaha laga helay qaacidada masaafada bar-xariiq. Qiimahani waa masaafada ilaa xariiqda AB, lamana odhan karo wuxuu la mid yahay masaafada ilaa qaybta.
n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.r.c: Tani waa masaafada ilaa dhammaadka A. Hubi haddii aad dooratay kan labada dhammaad ka dhow.

n-m-h1-geo-09.s.s1.explain: Masaafada ilaa xariiqda AB waa |21−4|/5=17/5, laakiin cidhifka qotomada laga bilaabo P ilaa xariiqda wuxuu ku yaal qaybta dibaddeeda (B ka shisheeya). Sidaas darteed barta ugu dhow ee qaybta waa dhammaadka B, masaafo √(9+4)=√13≈3.61. Tani waa ka weyn 17/5=3.4.
