n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.r.a: Haddii ay yihiin matrix-yo laba-jibbaaran, ku dhufashooyinka waa la xisaabin karaa, laakiin tani ma aha shuruud gabi ahaanba lagama maarmaan ah. Haddii A uu yahay 2×3 B na uu yahay 3×2, matrix-yo laba-jibbaaran ma aha, haddana labada AB iyo BA waa la xisaabin karaa.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.b: Tirada tiirarka A waxay le'eg tahay tirada safafka B
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.c: Tirooyinka safafka A iyo B waa siman yihiin, tirooyinka tiirarka A iyo B na waa siman yihiin
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.r.c: Kani waa shuruudda ah in labada matrix ay leeyihiin cabbir isku mid ah. Haddii ay leeyihiin cabbir isku mid ah, wadarta waa la xisaabin karaa, laakiin isla cabbir macnaheedu ma aha in ku dhufasho kasta la xisaabin karo, mana aha shuruud gabi ahaanba lagama maarmaan ah. Xitaa cabbirro kala duwan, 2×3 iyo 3×2, labada AB iyo BA waa la xisaabin karaa.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.o.d: Tirada tiirarka B waxay le'eg tahay tirada safafka A
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s1.explain: AB waa la xisaabin karaa marka tirada tiirarka A, q, ay le'eg tahay tirada safafka B, r, BA na waa la xisaabin karaa marka tirada tiirarka B, s, ay le'eg tahay tirada safafka A, p. Labadan shuruudood oo keliya ayaa loo baahan yahay; matrix-yadu ma noqon karaan inay laba-jibbaaran yihiin ama isku cabbir.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo gali saddex set oo kala duwan (p, q, r, s) oo tirooyin dhan ah 1 ilaa 6 oo labada AB iyo BA la xisaabin karo laakiin AB iyo BA ay leeyihiin cabbirro kala duwan.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qor shuruudda AB la xisaabin karo iyo shuruudda BA la xisaabin karo sida isla'egaha, oo muuji cabbirka AB iyo cabbirka BA marka loo eego p, q, r, s.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hel shuruudda loo baahan yahay u dhexeysa p iyo q si labada cabbir ay u kala duwanaadaan.

n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Afarta lambar waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo 1 ilaa 6.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c2: AB lama xisaabin karo. Tirada tiirarka A iyo tirada safafka B way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c3: BA lama xisaabin karo. Tirada tiirarka B iyo tirada safafka A way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.ok.c4: AB iyo BA waxay leeyihiin cabbirro kala duwan.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.fail.c4: AB iyo BA waxay leeyihiin cabbir isku mid ah.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s2.explain: AB wuxuu leeyahay cabbir p×s BA na wuxuu leeyahay cabbir r×q. Haddii q=r iyo s=p, markaas AB waa p×p BA na waa q×q, sidaas darteed cabbirradooda way kala duwan yihiin marka p≠q. Tusaale ahaan, haddii A uu yahay 2×3 B na uu yahay 3×2, markaas AB waa 2×2 BA na waa 3×3.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.prompt: Ee A iyo B sidaas ah (tusaale ahaan, A waa 2×3 B na waa 3×2), qor sababta aynaan u odhan karin AB=BA. Kadib hal weedh ku qor sida tani u tahay nooc hadal oo ka duwan "waxaa jira tusaale halka AB≠BA ee laba matrix oo AB iyo BA ay leeyihiin cabbir isku mid ah" (tusaale ahaan, A=[[1,1],[0,1]], B=[[1,0],[1,1]]).
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor tirada unugyada (tirada safafka × tirada tiirarka) ee AB iyo BA oo barbar dhig.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir waxa ay tahay inay siman yihiin si matrix-yo loogu yeero siman, oo barbar dhig qaybta shuruuddaas ee labada xaaladood mid kastaa jebiyo.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma heshay cabbirrada AB iyo BA?

n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.0: AB waa 2×2 BA na waa 3×3, sidaas darteed cabbirradooda way kala duwan yihiin. Matrix-yo cabbirro kala duwan leh xitaa lama barbar dhigi karo sinnaanta. Xaalad AB≠BA ee matrix-yo isku cabbir ah waa mid cabbirradu isku mid yihiin laakiin qiimayaasha unugyadu kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed waa nooc hadal oo kala duwan.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.1: AB iyo BA waxay leeyihiin cabbirro kala duwan, sidaas darteed ma odhan karno waa siman yihiin. Tani way ka duwan tahay xaalad AB iyo BA ay leeyihiin cabbir isku mid ah laakiin gelinno kala duwan. Dhamaadka dambe, waa la barbar dhigi karaa, laakiin qiimayaashu way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-mat-07.s.s3.model.2: AB waa 2×2 BA na waa 3×3, sidaas darteed cabbirradooda way kala duwan yihiin lamana barbar dhigi karo. Tusaalaha 2×2, cabbirradu isku mid yihiin laakiin gelinnadu way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed qiimayaashu waa kala duwan yihiin.

n-m-h1-mat-08.prereq.1: Shuruudda ad−bc≠0 ee matrix 2×2 uu u leeyahay rogan
n-m-h1-mat-08.title: Haddii rogan jiro, ma samayn karnaa bartilmaameed kasta?
n-m-h1-mat-08.topic: Matrix-yada: fasiraadda xal lagu helay rogan sida shuruud adduunka dhabta ah
n-m-h1-mat-08.goal: Xataa marka rogan jiro oo xalku si gaar ah loo go'aamiyo, wuxuu laga yaabaa inuusan buuxin shuruud dhab ah (cadadyada ugu yaraan 0). Tan hubi adigoo dhisaya tusaale lid ku ah, oo labada xaqiiqo si gooni ah u sharax.
n-m-h1-mat-08.material: Waxaad rabtaa inaad isku darto laba nooc oo cunto xoolaad ah, X iyo Y, si cadadka laba nafaqo loogu helo bartilmaameed (p, q). 1 kg oo X ah wuxuu leeyahay 2 cutub oo nafaqada 1 ah iyo 1 cutub oo nafaqada 2 ah, 1 kg oo Y ah na wuxuu leeyahay 1 cutub oo nafaqada 1 ah iyo 1 cutub oo nafaqada 2 ah. Haddii aad isku darto x kg oo X ah iyo y kg oo Y ah, cadadka nafaqooyinku waxay buuxiyaan A(x, y)=(p, q) marka A=[[2,1],[1,1]], taasoo ah, 2x+y=p, x+y=q. Matrixkan A wuxuu leeyahay rogan sababtoo ah ad−bc=2·1−1·1=1. Cadadka cuntada x, y waa inay noqdaan ugu yaraan 0 (ma isku dari kartid tiro taban oo kg ah).
n-m-h1-mat-08.thinking.0: Kala saarista in xal jiro iyo in xalka lagu isticmaali karo dhabta
n-m-h1-mat-08.thinking.1: Naqshadaynta tusaale lid ku ah oo aan buuxin shuruudda
n-m-h1-mat-08.prereq.0: Qorista nidaam isla'egyo toosan sida matrix
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro waxa la hubo in la odhan karo xaqiiqda ah in A uu leeyahay rogan.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.hint.0: Dooro hal bartilmaameed (p, q), naftaada u xalli nidaamka 2x+y=p, x+y=q, oo hubi qiimayaasha x iyo y qaadanayaan.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bedel p iyo q oo samee xisaabtaas isku mid ah, kadibna la barbar dhig doorashooyinka.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.a: Bartilmaameed kasta (p, q), isla'egtu waxay leedahay dhowr xal (x, y)
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.a: Haddii rogan jiro, xalku waa mid gaar ah. Dhowr xal oo jiraan waxay dhacdaa marka rogan jirin.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.b: Bartilmaameed kasta (p, q), isla'egtu waxay leedahay saxda hal xal (x, y)
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.c: Bartilmaameed leh p iyo q togan, x iyo y sidoo kale had iyo jeer waxay soo baxaan togan
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.c: Jiritaanka rogan macnaheedu waa in xal jiro; ma go'aamiyo calaamadaha xalka. Tan waad arki kartaa adigoo naftaada u xallinaya bartilmaameed sida p=1, q=3.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.o.d: Bartilmaameed kasta (p, q), waxaa jira saxda hal xal oo leh x, y ugu yaraan 0
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.r.d: Xalka oo si gaar ah loo go'aamiyey way ka duwan tahay xalka oo ah ugu yaraan 0. Shuruudda dhabta ah x, y≥0 rogan ma dammaanad qaado.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s1.explain: Maadaama A uu leeyahay rogan, (x, y)=A⁻¹(p, q) wuxuu go'aamiyaa saxda hal xal bartilmaameed kasta. Laakiin calaamadaha xalkaas waxay ku xiran yihiin bartilmaameedka, sidaa darteed hal xal oo jiro way ka duwan tahay in laga samayn karo cunto.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.prompt: Hel oo geli saddex bartilmaameed oo kala duwan (p, q) halkaas oo p iyo q labaduba togan yihiin laakiin xalka 2x+y=p, x+y=q uu ka kooban yahay tiro taban.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel tibaaxaha x iyo y ee p iyo q ku salaysan (ka jarista labada isla'ego way fududaysaa).
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.hint.1: Qor xiriirka u dhexeeya cabbirrada p iyo q marka x uu yahay taban, iyo marka y uu yahay taban.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.ok.c3: Xalka dhexdiisa, x ama y waa taban.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Bartilmaameedkan wuxuu leeyahay xal leh x, y labaduba ugu yaraan 0, sidaa darteed waxaa laga samayn karaa cunto.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s2.explain: x=p−q, y=2q−p. Tusaale ahaan, (p,q)=(1,3) x=−2 y=5, sidaa darteed x waa taban. (5,2) x=3 y=−1, sidaa darteed y waa taban. (3,2) waxaa lagu samayn karaa x=1, y=1, (4,2) na x=2, y=0, sidaa darteed waa la samayn karaa adigoo aan Y ku darin.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.prompt: Bartilmaameed halkaas oo p iyo q labaduba togan yihiin laakiin xalku ka kooban yahay tiro taban waa in lagu xukumaa "lama samayn karo." Qor sababta, oo kala saar waxa jiritaanka rogan dammaanad qaadayo iyo waxa uusan dammaanad qaadin duruuftan.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.hint.0: Dooro hal tusaale oo xalku leeyahay tiro taban, oo ereyo ku qor waxa tirada tabanu dhab ahaan macnaheedu noqon lahaa marka cunto la isku daro.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.hint.1: Laba sadar ku qor waxa rogan dammaanad qaado (jiritaanka iyo gaarnimada xalka) iyo shuruudda dhibaatadu si gooni ah u dalbato (x, y≥0).
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma kala saartay waxa rogan dammaanad qaado iyo shuruudda dhibaatadu si gooni ah u dalbato?
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma fasirtay macnaha tirada tabanu ereyada isku darka cuntada?
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.model.0: Maadaama rogan jiro, bartilmaameed kasta xalka (x,y) ee isla'egtu waa mid gaar ah. Laakiin haddii xalkaas uu leeyahay tiro taban, ma isku dari kartid tiro taban oo kg cunto ah, sidaa darteed dhab ahaan lama samayn karo. Rogan wuxuu dammaanad qaadaa in xal jiro, laakiin ma dammaanad qaado shuruudda dhabta ah ee x, y ay yihiin ugu yaraan 0.
n-m-h1-mat-08.s.s3.model.1: Sababtoo ah A wuxuu leeyahay rogan, xal had iyo jeer waa la heli karaa, laakiin haddii x ama y ay soo baxdo taban, macnaheedu waa inaan cunto ka saarno, taasoo dhab ahaan aan suurtagal ahayn. Sidaa darteed in xal jiro iyo in dhab ahaan la samayn karo waa laba shay oo kala duwan.

n-m-h1-mat-09.title: Ma rogan (A+B) waa isugeynta rogan A iyo rogan B?
n-m-h1-mat-09.topic: Matrix-yada: roganyada iyo isugeynada, iyo shuruudaha tusaalaha lid ku ah
n-m-h1-mat-09.goal: Garo in tusaale lid ku ah labada dhinac ee sheegashadu ay tahay inay qeexan yihiin, dhis tusaale lid ku ah oo buuxiya shuruudaha, oo sharax sababta tusaale si kediso ah u run ahi uusan caddayn u ahayn.
n-m-h1-mat-09.material: Arday ayaa sheegay, "Laba matrix A iyo B, (A+B)⁻¹ = A⁻¹ + B⁻¹ had iyo jeer waa run." Si loo beeniyo sheegashadan waxaan u baahanahay tusaale lid ku ah, oo si loo dhiso tusaale lid ku ah, labada dhinac ee sheegashadu waa inay macno yeeshaan. (E waa matrixka aqoonsiga [[1,0],[0,1]], O waa matrixka eber oo dhammaan gelitaanadiisu yihiin 0, [[a,b],[c,d]] na waa matrixka safka koowaad leh a, b iyo safka labaad leh c, d.)
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.0: Hubinta in tusaale lid ku ah uu buuxin karo mala-awaalka sheegashada (labada dhinac waa qeexan yihiin)
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.1: Naqshadaynta tusaale lid ku ah oo gaar ah iyo xaqiijinta shuruudaha
n-m-h1-mat-09.thinking.2: Garashada in hal tusaale oo run ah aanu caddayn ahayn
n-m-h1-mat-09.prereq.1: Shuruudda ad−bc≠0 si rogan u jiro
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan lammaanayaasha (A, B) ee ah tusaalayaal lid ku ah oo beeniya sheegashada.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, marka hore hubi haddii A⁻¹, B⁻¹, iyo (A+B)⁻¹ dhammaantood jiraan.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kaliya doorashooyinka saddexda rogan dhammaantood ay jiraan, si toos ah u xisaabi labada dhinac oo is barbar dhig.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.r.b: A+B waa matrixka eber, sidaa darteed rogan ma laha. Dhinaca bidix ee sheegashadu ma qeexna, sidaa darteed labada dhinac lama barbar dhigi karo, oo tusaale lid ku ah ma aha.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.r.d: B waa matrixka eber, sidaa darteed B⁻¹ ma jiro. Dhinaca midig ee sheegashadu ma qeexna, sidaa darteed tusaale lid ku ah ma aha.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s1.explain: Tusaale lid ku ah, A, B, iyo A+B dhammaantood waa inay leeyihiin rogan oo labada qiime waa inay kala duwanaadaan. Maadaama E+E=2E, (2E)⁻¹=½E, laakiin E⁻¹+E⁻¹=2E, sidaa darteed way kala duwan yihiin. Rogan diag(1,2)+E=diag(2,3) waa diag(½,⅓), laakiin A⁻¹+E=diag(2,3/2), sidaa darteed way kala duwan yihiin. Dhinaca kale, A=E, B=−E waxaan helnaa A+B=O, A=E, B=O na B⁻¹ ma jiro, sidaa darteed lama barbar dhigi karo.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.prompt: Go'; B ka dhig matrixka aqoonsiga E, oo hel oo geli saddex tusaale oo kala duwan oo lid ku ah A=[[a,b],[c,d]] oo leh gelitaano tirooyin dhan ah kuwaas oo sheegashada (A+E)⁻¹=A⁻¹+E ay fashilanto.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.hint.0: Si labadaba A iyo A+E ay u leeyihiin rogan, mid kastaba waa inuu lahaado ad−bc aan la simnayn 0. Qor labada shuruudood sida tibaaxo.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore tijaabi matrix-yo fudud sida A=E iyo A=2E, kadibna wax yar bedel gelitaannada oo hubi shuruudaha.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.ok.c3: (A+E)⁻¹ iyo A⁻¹+E way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.fail.c3: A-gan, (A+E)⁻¹ iyo A⁻¹+E si kediso ah ayay isle'eg yihiin. Sheegashadu tusaalahan dhexdiisa waa run.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s2.explain: Haddii A=E, markaas (2E)⁻¹=½E, laakiin E⁻¹+E=2E, sidaa darteed way kala duwan yihiin. A badan, sheegashadu sidan ayay u fashilantaa. Laakiin A=[[0,−1],[1,−1]] way ka duwan tahay. A⁻¹=[[−1,1],[−1,0]], rogan A+E=[[1,−1],[1,0]] waa [[0,1],[−1,1]], A⁻¹+E=[[0,1],[−1,1]] na, sidaa darteed labada qiime way isle'eg yihiin. [[1,0],[0,0]] ma shaqeeyo sababtoo ah A rogan ma laha, −E na ma shaqeeyo sababtoo ah A+E waa matrixka eber.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.prompt: Tallaabadii hore, A=[[0,−1],[1,−1]] ma noqon tusaale lid ku ah. A-gan, hel (A+E)⁻¹ iyo A⁻¹+E oo is barbar dhig. Kadibna go'aami oo qor haddii xaqiiqda ah in labada qiime ay isle'eg yihiin tusaalahan ay caddaynayso sheegashada "(A+B)⁻¹=A⁻¹+B⁻¹."
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.hint.0: Si aad u hesho rogan A, marka hore hel ad−bc, kadibna ku dhufo [[d,−b],[−c,a]] 1/(ad−bc). A+E waa matrixka aad hesho marka aad marka hore isku darto gelitaannada.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.hint.1: Kadib marka aad barbar dhigto labada natiijo, sidoo kale la barbar dhig natiijada A=E ee tallaabadii hore.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma naftaada u xisaabisay labada rogan?
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay "hal tusaale ayay run tahay" iyo "dhammaan xaaladaha ayay run tahay"?
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.0: A⁻¹=[[−1,1],[−1,0]], rogan A+E=[[1,−1],[1,0]] waa [[0,1],[−1,1]], A⁻¹+E na waa [[0,1],[−1,1]], sidaa darteed way isle'eg yihiin. Laakiin hal tusaale oo run ah macnaheedu maaha inay run tahay dhammaan A iyo B. Waxaa jira tusaale lid ku ah sida A=E, B=E, sidaa darteed sheegashadu waa khalad.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.1: Labada qiime dhammaantood waxay noqdeen [[0,1],[−1,1]]. Laakiin tani waa isle'eg kediso ahaan A gaar ahaan, oo waxaa jira xaalado sida A=E halkaas oo ay u soo baxaan kala duwan, sidaa darteed hal tusaalahan ma caddayn karo sheegashada.
n-m-h1-mat-09.s.s3.model.2: Labada qiime waxay isle'eg yihiin [[0,1],[−1,1]]. Laakiin hal tusaale oo sax ah macnaheedu maaha inay had iyo jeer run tahay, haddii uu jiro xataa hal tusaale lid ku ah, sheegashadu waa khalad.

n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gaar mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun adigoo isticmaalaya wixii aad hadda taqaanid oo keliya.
n-m-h1-eq-05.prereq.1: Isku darka iyo ku dhufashada tirooyinka isku-dhafan
n-m-h1-eq-05.title: Haddii tiro isku-dhafan ay tahay 0, ma odhan karnaa qaybta dhabta ah iyo qaybta khayaaliga ah labaduba waa 0?
n-m-h1-eq-05.topic: Sinnaanta tirooyinka isku-dhafan: shuruudda hoostooda qaybaha dhabta ah iyo khayaaliga ah si gooni ah loo isbarbar dhigi karo
n-m-h1-eq-05.goal: Fahan, adigoo dib u eegaya xukunkaaga marka macluumaadku kordho, in ka hor isticmaalka shuruudda sinnaanta tirooyinka isku-dhafan aad marka hore waa inaad hubisaa nooca tirooyinka xarfuhu yihiin, oo naftaada samee tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h1-eq-05.material: Waxaa jira tibaaxda (a−2)+(b+1)i=0. Waxaan rabnaa inaan go'aamino a iyo b tibaaxdan. Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gaar mar.
n-m-h1-eq-05.thinking.0: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga marka macluumaad cusub muuqdo
n-m-h1-eq-05.thinking.1: Sheeg shuruudaha hoostooda xeer run yahay
n-m-h1-eq-05.thinking.2: Samee tusaale lid ku ah oo ku hubi gelin
n-m-h1-eq-05.prereq.0: Macnaha tirada isku-dhafan a+bi (a, b waa dhab)
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.hint.0: Mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub muuqdo, hubi haddii xeerkii aad hore u isticmaashay uu weli run yahay macluumaadkaas hoostiisa.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.hint.1: Si toos ah ugu geli qiimayaasha tibaaxda oo tijaabi haddii a=2, b=−1 runtii ay tahay inay noqdaan.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Tibaaxda (a−2)+(b+1)i=0 ayaa la bixiyey. Weli lama oga nooca tirooyinka a iyo b ay yihiin.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Maxaad ka odhan kartaa a iyo b?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Arday badan ayaa u qaata a iyo b inay dhab yihiin oo isla markiiba isticmaala xeerka. Laakiin dhibaatadu ma sheegto nooca tirooyinka a iyo b ay yihiin.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad isla markiiba isticmaashay xeerka ah haddii tiro isku-dhafan ay tahay 0, qaybaheeda dhabta ah iyo khayaaliga ah labaduba waa 0. Waa xukunka marka hore maskaxda ku soo dhaca.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Weli lama go'aamin karo: marka hore waa inaan ogaano nooca tirooyinka a iyo b ay yihiin
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad aragtay in si loo isticmaalo xeerka, marka hore waa inaad hubisaa nooca tirooyinka xarfuhu yihiin.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: a=2 b na wuxuu noqon karaa tiro kasta
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay b muhiim ma aha inkasta oo b uu ku jiro tibaaxda. Mar kale eeg doorka b+1.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.info: a iyo b labaduba waa dhab.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda maxaad ka odhan kartaa a iyo b?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Ee tirooyin dhab ah x, y, haddii x+yi=0 markaas x=0 iyo y=0. Tani waa sababtoo ah tirooyinka dhabta ah x iyo y waxaa lagu kala saari karaa i. Sidaa darteed a=2, b=−1.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Waxaa jira sidoo kale xalal ka duwan a=2, b=−1
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Maadaama (a−2) iyo (b+1) ay dhab yihiin, tirooyinka i hortiisa ma is qasmaan. Si toos ah u tijaabi haddii xalal kale jiraan.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ma jiraan a, b buuxinaya tibaaxda
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Gelinta a=2, b=−1 waxay siinaysaa (0)+(0)i=0, sidaa darteed tibaaxdu waa run.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Gelinta a=2−i, b=0 waxay siinaysaa (2−i−2)+(0+1)i=−i+i=0. Tibaaxdu waa run. (Halkan a maaha dhab.)
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ee (a−2)+(b+1)i=0, shuruudee hoostooda ayaan ku gabagabayn karnaa a=2, b=−1?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Maadaama tirooyinka dhan ay dhab yihiin, doorashada c sidoo kale qalad ma aha. Laakiin shuruudda uu xeerkani u baahan yahay waa in a iyo b ay dhab yihiin. Haddii aadan hubin nooca tirooyinka xarfuhu yihiin, xeerka ma isticmaali kartid.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tusaalaha a=2−i, b=0, a ma aha 2. Waxaa jira caddayn ah inaysan ahayn "mar walba."
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Marka a iyo b ay yihiin dhab
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Marka a iyo b ay yihiin tirooyin dhan
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s1.reflect: Bilowgii waxaad rabtaa inaad isticmaasho xeerka isla markiiba, laakiin macluumaadka ah in xarfuhu yihiin dhab la'aantiis, gabagabadu way isbeddeli kartaa. Xeerka sinnaanta tirooyinka isku-dhafan waxaa la isticmaalaa kaliya marka "qaybta dhabta ah iyo qaybta khayaaliga ahi labaduba yihiin dhab."
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.prompt: Samee a iyo b oo buuxiya (a−2)+(b+1)i=0 halka a aan dhab ahayn, oo qor xisaabta muujinaysa in beddelka odhaahda uu siinayo 0.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.hint.0: Geli qiime fudud b, xisaabi waxa (b+1)i yahay, ka dibna dib u shaqee si aad u hesho a baabi'inaya.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.hint.1: Beddel a iyo b aad heshay odhaahda asalka ah oo hubi in xisaabtu siinayso 0 iyo in a aan dhab ahayn.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma go'aamisay b marka hore oo dib u shaqeysay si aad u hesho a?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay in a aan dhab ahayn?
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.model.0: Haddii b=0, markaas (a−2)+i=0, sidaas darteed qaado a=2−i. Hubin: (2−i−2)+(0+1)i=−i+i=0, a=2−i na ma aha dhab.
n-m-h1-eq-05.s.s2.model.1: Dhig b=i. Markaas (b+1)i=(i+1)i=−1+i. Sidaas darteed qaadashada a=3−i waxay siinaysaa (3−i−2)+(−1+i)=0, a na ma aha dhab.

n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gaar mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun adigoo isticmaalaya wixii aad hadda taqaanid oo keliya.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.title: Xalka Nidaamka Sinaan La'aanta: Maxaa Is Beddela Marka a Is Beddelo?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.goal: Nidaam sinaan la'aan oo ka kooban xarafka a, sii sheeg oo dib u eeg sida qaabka kooxda xalku u is beddelo iyadoo qiimaha a, oo go'aami haddii qiimayaasha xadka ay ku jiraan.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.material: Eeg xalka nidaamka x² − x − 6 ≥ 0, x < a iyadoo ku xidhan qiimaha a. Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal qayb mar.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.thinking.0: Isku dul dhigidda kooxaha xalka xariiqda tirooyinka
n-m-h1-ineq-04.thinking.1: Go'aaminta haddii qiime xad ku jiro (calaamadda sinaanta)
n-m-h1-ineq-04.thinking.2: U kala qaybinta kiisas iyadoo loo eegayo qiimaha
n-m-h1-ineq-04.prereq.1: Xalka nidaamka sinaan la'aanta waa qaybta guud
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore ku sawir xalka sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa xariiqda tirooyinka, kadibna kor ku dul dhig x<a.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Marka macluumaad cusub soo baxo, marka hore hubi haddii qiimaha xadku leeyahay calaamad sinaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxaa jira nidaamka { x² − x − 6 ≥ 0 , x < a }. Jajabinta sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa waxay siinaysaa (x+2)(x−3) ≥ 0, xalkeeduna waa x ≤ −2 ama x ≥ 3. Qiimaha a weli lama garanayo.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tiro kasta oo a yahay, nidaamkan ma leeyahay xal?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.after: x<a waa wax kasta oo bidix ka ah a xariiqda tirooyinka, had iyo jeerna waxay ka kooban tahay tirooyin ka yar −2, sidaas darteed a kasta waxaa jira xal. Laakiin qaabka kooxda xalku wuu is beddeli karaa iyadoo ku xidhan a.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: a kasta waxaa jira xal: x<a had iyo jeer waxay ku jirtaa tirooyin ka yar −2
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Haddii a ≤ −2 xal ma jiro: kuma dul dhacdo xalka sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Haddii a ugu badnaan yahay −2, x kasta oo x<a ah waa ka yar yahay −2 oo wuxuu buuxiyaa sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa. Dareenka ah inaysan is dul dhicin waxay ahayd xukun la gaaray iyadoo aan lagu sawirin xariiqda tirooyinka.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Haddii a ≤ 3 xal ma jiro: kuma dul dhacdo qaybta x ≥ 3
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Xitaa haddii aysan ku dul dhicin qaybta x ≥ 3, waxay ku dul dhacdaa qaybta x ≤ −2. Waxaad eegtay hal qayb oo keliya oo ka mid ah kooxda xalka.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Hadda waa la ogyahay in a = −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Qaybta guud ee x<−2 iyo (x ≤ −2 ama x ≥ 3) waa x<−2. −2, sinaan la'aanta labaad ma qabsoonto.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa waxay oggolaanaysaa x=−2, laakiin sinaan la'aanta labaad x<−2 ma oggola −2. Labada shuruudood waa in la buuxiyo.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Tiro ka yar −2, sida x=−3, waxay buuxisaa labada sinaan la'aan.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Markan waa la ogyahay in a = 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Maadaama x<3, qaybta x ≥ 3 midna ma soo gali karto, kooxda xalkuna waa x ≤ −2. Haddii calaamadda sinaan la'aanta aysan lahayn sinaan, qiimaha xadka waa laga reebaa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: x=3 wuxuu buuxiyaa sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa laakiin ma buuxiyo sinaan la'aanta labaad x<3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: x=0 wuxuu buuxiyaa x<3, laakiin sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa (x+2)(x−3) = −6 ≥ 0 waa been.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.info: Ugu dambeyn waa la ogyahay in a = 5.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.after: Sababtoo ah "≥" ee sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa, 3 waa ku jirta, sababtoo ah "<" ee sinaan la'aanta labaad, 5 waa laga reebay. Marka a ka weyn tahay 3, kooxda xalku waxay u kala qaybsantaa laba qaybood.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.r.a: x=3 wuxuu ku jiraa xalka sababtoo ah sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa waxay leedahay calaamadda sinaanta. Waxaad ka reebtay qiimaha xadka 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Sinaan la'aanta labaad waa x<5, sidaas darteed x=5 laguma dari karo.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s1.reflect: Marka a is beddelo, kooxda xalku waxay noqon kartaa hal dhex ama laba qaybood. Haddii qiime xad ku jiro waxay ku xidhan tahay haddii calaamadda sinaan la'aanta ay leedahay sinaan, marka xadka labada sinaan la'aan uu ku kulmo isla bar, "<" dhinac ahaan waxay ka reebi kartaa barta.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qiimayaasha a ee hoose ee kooxda xalku tahay hal dhex isku xiran xariiqda tirooyinka, jabin la'aan.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.hint.0: a kasta, ku sawir x<a xariiqda tirooyinka oo hadhuuduh qaybta ku dul dhacda xalka sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Barbar dhig qaybaha is dul dhaca marka a u dhexeyso −2 iyo 3 iyo marka a ka weyn tahay 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.r.a: Haddii a=7, markaas x ≤ −2 ama 3 ≤ x < 7, taasoo ah laba qaybood.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.r.c: Haddii a=3.5, markaas x ≤ −2 ama 3 ≤ x < 3.5, sidaas darteed hal qayb oo gaaban oo kale ayaa hadha taasina waa laba qaybood.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s2.explain: Haddii a=−2, xalku waa x<−2, haddii a=1 na waa x ≤ −2, mid kasta hal dhex. Haddii a ka weyn tahay 3, 3 ≤ x < a ayaa soo muuqata oo waxay noqotaa laba qaybood.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.prompt: Qor sababta x=3 aysan u noqon karin xal marka a=3. Sidoo kale qor sida kooxda xalku u is beddesho haddii a xitaa wax yar ka weyn tahay 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.hint.0: Geli x=3 labada sinaan la'aan mid walba oo hubi kee ayaan qabsoon.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.hint.1: Geli tirooyin wax yar ka weyn 3, sida a=3.1 ama 3.01, oo eeg tirooyinka 3 agtiisa ah ee cusub u soo galaya.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.placeholder: tus., Gelinta x=3 waxay siinaysaa ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma gelisay x=3 sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa iyo tan labaad gooni gooni?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qori kartaa, sida sinaan la'aan, dhexda cusub ee soo muuqata marka a ka weyn tahay 3?
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.0: x=3 wuxuu buuxiyaa sinaan la'aanta ugu horreysa (x+2)(x−3)≥0, laakiin ma buuxiyo sinaan la'aanta labaad x<3 (sababtoo ah sinaan ma jirto). Haddii a xitaa wax yar ka weyn tahay 3, markaas 3≤x<a ayaa hadha, taasoo ah qayb ka go'an x≤−2, taasoo ka dhigaysa laba qaybood.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.1: Haddii a=3, markaas x<3, laakiin 3 ma ka yara 3, sidaas darteed ma shaqeyso. Haddii a yahay 3.1, tirooyinka laga bilaabo 3 ilaa laga reebo 3.1 ayaa soo gala xalka, sidaas darteed xalku wuxuu u kala qaybsamaa laba dhex.
n-m-h1-ineq-04.s.s3.model.2: Gelinta 3 sinaan la'aanta labaad x<3 waxay siinaysaa 3<3, taasoo been ah, sidaas darteed 3 waxaa laga reebay xalka. Haddii a>3, markaas 3≤x<a ayaa lagu daraa kooxda xalkuna waa jabay qaybo.

n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.prompt: Macluumaadka waxaa la muujiyaa hal gaar mar. Tallaabo kasta, dooro xukun adigoo isticmaalaya wixii aad hadda taqaanid oo keliya.
n-m-h1-logic-03.title: Haddii Isgoysyadu Siman Yihiin Ama Midowyadu Siman Yihiin, Ma Labada Set Waa Siman Yihiin?
n-m-h1-logic-03.goal: Fahan in hawlgallada set-ka, aadan "baabi'in karin" isla set sida ku dhufashada tirooyinka, oo go'aami shuruudaha loo baahan yahay si loo yiraahdo B=C.
n-m-h1-logic-03.material: Saddex set-hoose A, B, C oo set-ka guud U ka mid ah, waxaan rabnaa inaan ogaano haddii B iyo C ay yihiin isla set. Macluumaadka aad ogtahay waxaa la muujiyaa hal-hal.
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.0: Dib u eegidda xukunkaaga mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub la bixiyo
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.1: Samaynta tusaale B≠C oo buuxiya shuruudda
n-m-h1-logic-03.thinking.2: Ka fikirka gooni gooni gudaha A iyo banaanka A
n-m-h1-logic-03.prereq.1: Macnaha laba set oo siman (dhammaan curyaannadu waa isku mid)
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.hint.0: Eeg haddii shuruudda hadda la ogyahay ay ka hadlayso curyaannada gudaha A ama curyaannada banaanka A.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.hint.1: Samee tusaale yar oo set-yo ah oo B iyo C ay kala duwan yihiin laakiin shuruudda la ogyahay ay run tahay.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxa kaliya ee la ogyahay waa A∩B=A∩C.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma gabagabeyn kartaa B=C macluumaadkan oo keliya?
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Tusaale ahaan, haddii A={1,2}, B={2,3}, C={2,4}, markaas A∩B=A∩C={2} laakiin B≠C. Isgoys wuxuu eegaa curyaannada gudaha A oo keliya, sidaas darteed ma ogaan karno haddii B iyo C ay ku kala duwan yihiin banaanka A.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Haa: isgoysyada isla A waa siman yihiin, sidaas darteed B iyo C sidoo kale waa siman yihiin
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad xaqiiqda ah in isgoysyadu siman yihiin si toos ah ugu gudbisay in B oo dhan siman yahay.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Haa: sida baabi'inta wax-isku-dhufashada tirooyinka, ka saarista A labada dhinac waxay siinaysaa B=C
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad u malaysay inaad baabi'in karto sida ku dhufashada tirooyinka. Haddii taasi ka shaqeyso isgoysyada set-yada waxay u baahan tahay in la hubiyo.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Maya: B iyo C oo leh curyaanno kala duwan banaanka A ayaa wali yeelan kara isgoysyo siman A
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waxaad ka fikirtay xaqiiqda ah isgoys wuxuu eegaa curyaannada gudaha A oo keliya.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sidoo kale waa la xaqiijiyey in A∪B=A∪C run yahay. (A∩B=A∩C weli sidoo kale waa run.)
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ha noqdo x∈B. Haddii x uu ka tirsan yahay A, markaas x∈A∩B=A∩C, sidaas darteed x∈C; haddii x aanu ka tirsanayn A, markaas laga bilaabo x∈A∪B=A∪C waxaan helnaa x∈C. Si ka soo horjeeda, laga bilaabo C waxaan helnaa B si isku mid ah, sidaas darteed B=C.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Weli lama ogaan karo: labada shuruudoodba waa macluumaad la xiriira A oo keliya
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ma isku darin xaqiiqda ah in labada shuruudood ay ka hadlayaan gudaha A iyo banaanka A siday u kala horreeyaan.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: B=C: shuruudda isgoysku waxay ka dhigtaa gudaha A mid isku mid ah, shuruudda midowguna waxay ka dhigtaa banaanka A mid isku mid ah
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: B≠C: haddii midowyadu siman yihiin, isgoysyadu waa inay kala duwan yihiin
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad u malaysay in shuruudaha midowga iyo isgoysku is diidaan.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Shuruudda isgoyska A∩B=A∩C si khaldan ayaa loo gudbiyey. Waxa dhab ahaan la xaqiijiyey waa A∪B=A∪C oo keliya.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Haddii A={1}, B={2}, C={1,2}, markaas A∪B=A∪C={1,2} laakiin B≠C. Midow, xitaa haddii curyaan mar horeba A ku jira uu ka maqan yahay B, A ayaa buuxisa, sidaas darteed midowga oo keliya ma muujin karo in B iyo C ay siman yihiin.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Maya: xitaa haddii midowyadu siman yihiin, curyaannada B iyo C ee gudaha A way kala duwanaan karaan
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Haa: horey ayaan u xukumay B=C, sidaas darteed waa sidii hore

n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad xaqiiqda ah in midowyadu siman yihiin ka dhigtay in curyaannada B iyo C ay isku mid yihiin.
n-m-h1-logic-03.s.s1.reflect: Macluumaadka ah in isgoysyadu siman yihiin wuxuu kuu sheegayaa sida B iyo C u egyihiin gudaha A oo keliya, macluumaadka ah in midowyadu siman yihiin na wuxuu kuu sheegayaa banaanka A oo keliya. Waxaad odhan kartaa B=C kaliya marka labaduba jiraan, haddii mid baaba'o waa inaad gabagabada ka noqotaa.

n-m-h1-ineq-01.title: Halkee ayuu xalka ugu yaraanta x + 4/x ku khaldamay?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.goal: Xal helay ugu yaraan adigoo isticmaalaya xidhiidhka celceliska xisaabta iyo celceliska joomatariga, hel xaaladda aan qaacidada la isticmaali karin, oo hagaaji gabagabada adigoo bedelaya qiyamka.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.material: Jiu wuxuu xaliyay dhibaatada "Hel qiimaha ugu yar ee x + 4/x marka x uu yahay lambar dhab ah oo aan eber ahayn" sida hoos ku qoran. (4/x waa lambarka 4 oo loo qaybiyey x.) Akhri xalka oo jawaab su'aalaha.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.thinking.0: Hubinta shuruudaha isticmaalka qaacidada ka hor intaadan isticmaalin
n-m-h1-ineq-01.thinking.1: Helista tusaale lid ku ah adigoo bedelaya qiyamka
n-m-h1-ineq-01.thinking.2: Kala qaybinta kiisaska si loo hagaajiyo gabagabada
n-m-h1-ineq-01.prereq.0: Ogaanshaha xidhiidhka celceliska xisaabta iyo joomatariga (a+b ≥ 2√(ab) a, b togan)
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan ee xalka Jiu.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi mid mid haddii safaf kasta uu si sax ah uga yimid safka isla markiiba ka horreeya.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Safka isticmaalaya qaacido, qor shuruudda ay qaacidadu run ka tahay oo barbar dhig shuruudda x ee dhibaatada lagu bixiyay.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.line.0: Si loo helo ugu yaraanta x + 4/x, isticmaal xidhiidhka celceliska xisaabta iyo joomatariga.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.line.3: Sinnaantu waa run marka x = 4/x, sidaas darteed x = 2 ama x = −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.line.4: Sidaas darteed qiimaha ugu yar waa 4.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa safka ugu horreeya ee khaldan. a+b ≥ 2√(ab) waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka a iyo b labaduba yihiin togan (ama ugu yaraan 0) oo keliya, laakiin x waa lambar dhab ah oo aan eber ahayn, sidaas darteed wuu noqon karaa taban. Safafka 3 iyo wixii ka dambeeya waxay ka soo baxaan safka 2.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.prompt: Dooro qiime x oo ku beddel si aad u muujiso in gabagabada Jiu ay khalad tahay, oo qor x kee ayaa sheegashada "ugu yaraan 4" ay sax tahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro dhowr lambar oo aad ku beddesho x, oo ay ku jiraan kuwo calaamado kala duwan leh, oo si toos ah u xisaabi x + 4/x.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.hint.1: Eeg haddii mid ka mid ah qiyamka la xisaabiyay uu ka hor imanayo sheegashada Jiu, iyo noocee lambar ayuu x yahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Marka x = ..., x + 4/x = ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma x aad dooratay waa taban?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma si toos ah u xisaabisay x + 4/x oo muujisay inay siinayso qiime ka yar 4?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegtay shuruudda x ee qaacidadu run ka tahay?
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.0: Bedelidda x=−1 waxay siinaysaa −1 + 4/(−1) = −5, taas oo ka yar 4. Sidaas darteed gabagabada Jiu waa khalad. Qaacidada a+b ≥ 2√(ab) waxaa la isticmaali karaa marka a iyo b ay togan yihiin oo keliya, sidaas darteed qiimaha ugu yar 4 waa sax marka x uu yahay togan oo keliya.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.1: Jiu ma eegin kiiska x uu yahay taban. Tusaale ahaan, haddii x = −2, markaas −2 + (−2) = −4, taas oo ka yar 4. Gabagabada Jiu waa khalad, qiimuhuna waa ugu yaraan 4 marka x>0 oo keliya.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s2.model.2: Bedelidda x = −4 waxay siinaysaa −4 + 4/(−4) = −5. Waa ka yar yahay 4, sidaas darteed gabagabada Jiu waa khalad, qiimaha ugu yar-na waa 4 x togan oo keliya.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.prompt: Dooro hadalka saxda ah ee ku saabsan qiimaha x + 4/x marka x uu yahay taban.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.hint.0: Xisaabi dhowr qiime oo x taban ah oo ku qor miis.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii aad isticmaali karto xaqiiqda ah −x waa togan x taban si aad ugu beddesho natiijada lambarrada togan.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.o.a: Had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 4
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.a: Waxaad gabagabada Jiu ku dabaqday lambarro taban sida ay yihiin. Bedelidda x=−1 waxay siinaysaa −5.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.o.b: Had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan −4
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad beddeshay calaamadda natiijada togan oo keliya oo aad ka tagtay jihada calaamadda aan-sinnaanta sida ay ahayd. Marka ay noqoto taban, jihaduna sidoo kale way isbeddeshaa.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.o.c: Had iyo jeer waa ugu badnaan −4
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.o.d: Had iyo jeer waa ugu badnaan 4 laakiin ka weyn −4
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad u malaysay in qiimuhu u dhexeeyo −4 iyo 4. Bedelidda x=−1, −2, −4 waxay siinaysaa −5, −4, −5, kuwaas oo aan u dhexayn.
n-m-h1-ineq-01.s.s3.explain: Haddii x<0, markaas −x>0, sidaas darteed (−x) + 4/(−x) ≥ 4, ku dhufashada −1-na waxay siinaysaa x + 4/x ≤ −4. Sidaas darteed haddii x>0 waa ugu yaraan 4, haddii x<0 waa ugu badnaan −4, qiyamo u dhexeeya −4 iyo 4-na ma dhacaan.

n-m-h1-ineq-02.title: Baaxadda k ee u shaqeysa dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah: barbar dhigga laba xal
n-m-h1-ineq-02.goal: Marka la helayo shuruudda aan-sinnaanta in ay run tahay dhammaan x dhab ah, xukun haddii kiiska aan laba-jibbaaran ahayn si gooni gooni ah loo hubiyo, oo ku xaqiiji adigoo bedelaya qiyamka.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.material:
Dhibaato: Hel baaxadda lambarrada dhabta ah k ee aan-sinnaanta (k−1)x² − 2(k−1)x + 3 > 0 ay run tahay lambar dhab ah kasta x.

Hayun: Si aan-sinnaan laba-jibbaaran ay run u noqoto dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah, isku-dhufteha k−1 ee x² waa inuu ka weyn yahay 0, kala soocida D/4 = (k−1)² − 3(k−1) = (k−1)(k−4) waa inay ka yar tahay 0. Sidaas darteed 1<k<4.

Seojun: Hayun ma hubin kiiska k=1 si gooni gooni ah. Waxaan bedelay k=1 si aan u hubiyo, waxaan u malaynayaa 1≤k<4.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.thinking.0: Helista halka labada xal ay ku kala duwan yihiin
n-m-h1-ineq-02.thinking.1: Ku xaqiijinta xukunka adigoo bedelaya qiyamo matala
n-m-h1-ineq-02.thinking.2: Qorista sababaha adigoo kala qaybinaya kiisas

n-m-h1-ineq-02.prereq.1: Fududaynta tibaax adigoo bedelaya qiime xaraf ahaan
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xukunka saxda ah ee ku saabsan jawaabaha labada arday.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sida Seojun soo jeediyay, bedel k=1 tibaaxda oo qor sida tibaaxdu u isbeddesho.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sidoo kale bedel qiyamo aan ahayn k=1 (tusaale, 0, 2), oo hel qiyamka ka dhigaya labada jawaab inay kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.a: 1<k<4 ee Hayun waa sax. Maadaama ay tahay aan-sinnaan laba-jibbaaran, looma baahna in laga fikiro k=1.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.a: Had iyo jeer waxaad u maleysay in tibaax leh erayga laba-jibbaarka ay tahay laba-jibbaaran. Ma aadan hubin haddii qiime uu ka dhigayo isku-dhufteha 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.b: 1≤k<4 ee Seojun waa sax. Waa inaad bedesho k=1, hubiso, oo ku darto.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.c: Jawaabaha labada arday waa isla baaxad si kala duwan loo qoray.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.c: 1<k<4 iyo 1≤k<4 way ku kala duwan yihiin haddii k=1 la daro, sidaas darteed waa baaxado kala duwan.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.o.d: Labaduba waa khalad. Qiyamo qaar k<1 ah sidoo kale way shaqeeyaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.r.d: Haddii k<1, isku-dhufteha x² waa taban, sidaas darteed tibaaxdu waxay noqotaa taban marka x aad u weyn yahay. Waxaad ku xukuntay dareen adigoo aan qiyamka bedelin si aad u hubiso.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s1.explain: Haddii k=1, tibaaxdu waa 0·x² − 0·x + 3 = 3 > 0, sidaas darteed run bay u tahay dhammaan x dhab ah. Sidaas darteed k=1 sidoo kale waa lagu daray, Hayun-na wuxuu seegay kiiska isku-dhufteha eraygu laba-jibbaarka uu yahay 0. Jawaabtu waa 1≤k<4.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan qiyamka k ee soo socda ee (k−1)x² − 2(k−1)x + 3 > 0 run u tahay x dhab ah kasta.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.hint.0: K kasta bedel oo fududee, ka dibna hel x halka tibaaxdu ugu yartahay, ama hel hal x oo qiimihiisu yahay taban ama 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Haddii qiime kasta uu u muuqdo inuu khilaafsan yahay shuruudda kala soociga, barbar dhig qiimaha aad si toos ah u xisaabisay.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.r.a: Haddii k=4, tibaaxdu waa 3x² − 6x + 3 = 3(x−1)², taas oo ah 0 marka x=1, sidaas darteed ma aha "> 0." Waxaad ku darteen kiiska kala soociduhu yahay 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.r.c: Haddii k=0, tibaaxdu waa −x² + 2x + 3, taas oo ah −5 marka x=4, sidaas darteed run ma aha.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s2.explain: Haddii k=1 tibaaxdu waa 3, haddii k=3-na waa 2x² − 4x + 3 = 2(x−1)² + 1 > 0, sidaas darteed run bay tahay. k=0 qiimuhu waa −5 marka x=4, k=4-na waa 0 marka x=1, sidaas darteed run ma aha.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor sababta k=1 loo hubinayo si gooni gooni ah. Sidoo kale qor sababta kiiska k<1 aanu u shaqeynin.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qor waxa ku dhaca erayga x² iyo erayga x marka k=1.
n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Eeg waa maxay calaamadda isku-dhufteha x² marka k<1, iyo waxa ku dhaca qiimaha tibaaxda marka x yahay lambar aad u weyn.

n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.model.0: Haddii k=1, isku-dhufteyaasha erayada x² iyo x labaduba waa 0 tibaaxduna waxay noqotaa 3>0. n-m-h1-ineq-02.s.s3.model.2: Haddii k yahay 1, isku-dhufteyaashu waxay noqdaan 0 3>0 oo keliya ayaa hadha, taasoo run ah x kasta. Hayun kiiskan ma eegin. Haddii k ka yar yahay 1, isku-dhufteha x² waa taban yahay, sidaas darteed x aad u weyn qiimuhu waa taban.

n-m-h1-ineq-05.title: U Sharaxidda Milkiilaha Dukaanka Qiimayaasha Faa'iidada Leh
n-m-h1-ineq-05.goal: U gudbi xalka sinaan la'aanta labajibbaarka erayo maalinle ah qof aan aqoon qaacidooyin, oo qor saxda ah waxa dhaca qiimayaasha xadka.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.material: Dukaan, marka hal shay lagu iibiyo p kun won (p>0), faa'iidada maalinlaha ah waa (−p² + 14p − 24) kun won. Arday ayaa qorayo warbixin milkiilaha dukaanka. Milkiiluhu qaacidooyinka si fiican uma yaqaan wuxuuna rabaa inuu ogaado, "Marka qiimee ayaan ku iibiyaa?"
