n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.2: Sidaas darteed, madaxa, haddii aad qiimaha dejiso 2 kun won ama ka badan iyo 12 kun won ama ka yar, faa'iido ayaad samaynaysaa.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.line.3: Haddii aad dejiso ka sarreeya 12 kun won, runtii waxaad samaysaa khasaare.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 waa khalad. Xalku waa 2<p<12, calaamadaha sinaan la'aantuna sinaan ma laha. Haddii p=2 ama p=12, faa'iidadu saxda ah waa 0, sidaas darteed ma aha qiime faa'iido keena. Safafka 1, 2, iyo 4 waa sax.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.prompt: Sax safka 3 oo dib ugu qor sharaxaad 2 ilaa 3 jumladood oo milkiiluhu isla markiiba isticmaali karo. Looma baahna inaad isticmaasho qaacidooyin ama p. Hubi inaad ku darto xadka qiimayaasha iyo faa'iidada labada dhammaad ee xadkaas.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qor, sida jumladdaada koowaad, waxa milkiiluhu u badan yahay inuu rabo inuu marka hore maqlo markuu weydiiyo "Marka qiimee?"
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.hint.1: Geli labada qiime ee dhammaadka tibaaxda, xisaabi faa'iidada, oo natiijadaas ku dhig luqadda milkiilaha.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.placeholder: tus., Haddii aad qiimaha dejiso inta u dhexeysa ..., markaas ... Laakiin saxda ah ..., ...
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay xadka qiimayaasha faa'iidada leh si milkiiluhu u akhriyi karo oo isla markiiba u isticmaali karo?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ku hubisay xisaab in faa'iidadu tahay 0 labada qiime ee dhammaadka?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma gudbisay isla nuxurka adigoo aan isticmaalin astaamo qaacido?
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.0: Haddii aad qiimaha dejiso ka sarreeya 2 kun won oo ka hooseeya 12 kun won, faa'iido ayaad samaysaa. Saxda ah 2 kun ama 12 kun won, faa'iidadu waa 0, sidaas darteed waxaad is-dheelitirtaa oo keliya. Haddii aad ku iibiso ka badan 12 kun won, waad lumisaa lacag.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.1: Ku iibi ka badan 2 kun won oo ka yar 12 kun won. Haddii aad ku iibiso 2 kun ama 12 kun won, faa'iido ma samaysid (0 won).
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.model.2: Haddii aad qiimaha dejiso inta u dhexeysa 2 kun iyo 12 kun won, faa'iido ayaad samaysaa. Laakiin labada dhammaad, 2 kun iyo 12 kun won, faa'iido iyo khasaare midna ma jiro.
n-m-h1-ineq-05.s.s2.modelNote.2: Kani waa kiiska "u dhexeeya" loo isticmaalo macnaha ka reebista labada dhammaad; waa sax marka faa'iidada 0 ee labada dhammaad sidoo kale la qoro.

n-m-h1-ineq-06.title: Samaynta Sinaan La'aan Labajibbaar Leh Saxda Ah Hal Bar Xal
n-m-h1-ineq-06.goal: Ogow sida kooxda xalku u is beddesho iyadoo calaamadda sinaan la'aanta marka tibaax labajibbaar ah ay tahay labajibbaar buuxa, oo dhis sinaan la'aan labajibbaar ah oo xalkeedu yahay hal bar.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan xalino sinaan la'aanta labajibbaarka x² − 6x + 9 ≤ 0. Qaybta labajibbaarka ee tibaaxdan waxay leedahay qaab si fudud loo jajabin karo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.0: Sii sheegidda kooxda xalka qaabka tibaaxda
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.1: Naftaada u dhisidda tibaax ku habboon shuruudaha
n-m-h1-ineq-06.thinking.2: Beddelidda calaamadda sinaan la'aanta iyo barbar dhigidda kooxaha xalka
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.prompt: Dooro kooxda xalka saxda ah ee x² − 6x + 9 ≤ 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Jajabi tibaaxda oo ku qor qaabka (x−3)².
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir xadka qiimayaasha labajibbaar qaadan karo, oo geli x=3 iyo x=0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.b: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad u beddeshay (x−3)² ≤ 0 x−3 ≤ 0 adigoo ka saaray labajibbaarka. Labajibbaaristu waxay beddeshaa calaamadaha, sidaa darteed sidaas ma u beddeli kartid.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.c: Taasi waa jawaabta "≥ 0," ma aha "≤ 0." Labajibbaar had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 0, laakiin calaamadda sinnaan la'aanta ee ka soo horjeedda way ka duwan tahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.r.d: Gelinta x=3 waxay siinaysaa 0 ≤ 0, taasoo run ah. Waxaad u malaysay in tibaax laba-darajo ah had iyo jeer ay togan tahay, ama ma aadan si gooni ah u eegin xaaladda kala-soocaha uu yahay 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s1.explain: x² − 6x + 9 = (x − 3)², labajibbaar na waa ugu yaraan 0. Sidaa darteed si (x−3)² ≤ 0 u run noqoto, (x−3)² = 0, taasi waa, x = 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.prompt: Geli saddex lammaane tirooyin dhan oo kala duwan b, c oo xalka x² + bx + c ≤ 0 uu yahay hal tiro dhan oo togan oo keliya. (|b| ≤ 40)
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Indha-indhee waxa b iyo c ay ahaayeen tibaaxda tallaabada 1, samee dhowr tibaax oo qaab la mid ah, oo hubi haddii mid kasta uu leeyahay qaabka (x−p)².
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kordhi (x−p)² oo qor sida b iyo c loogu muujiyo p, kadibna isku day qiimayaal kala duwan oo p ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.ok.c1: b iyo c waa tirooyin dhan oo leh |b| ≤ 40.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c1: b iyo c waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo leh |b| ≤ 40.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.ok.c2: Tibaaxdu waxay leedahay saxda hal bar xal ahaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.fail.c2: Tibaaxdani ma laha saxda hal bar xal ahaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s2.explain: Haddii x² + bx + c = (x − p)², markaas b = −2p iyo c = p². Haddii p uu yahay tiro dhan oo togan, xalku waa kaliya x = p. (b, c) = (−2, 1), (−4, 4), (−10, 25), iyo wixii la mid ah dhammaantood way shaqeeyaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.prompt: Saddexda sinnaan la'aan ee laga helay x² − 6x + 9 adigoo calaamadda sinnaan la'aanta oo keliya beddelaya, ≥ 0, > 0, < 0, qor ururka xalka mid kasta, oo sharax hal safar sababta tani u dhacdo.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore kala saar haddii (x−3)² noqon karo taban iyo x kee ayuu la simanyahay 0.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Saddexda sinnaan la'aan mid kasta ku hubi gelinta x=3 iyo x=0, kadibna qor ururada xalka.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.placeholder: tusaale, ≥ 0 waa ..., > 0 waa ..., < 0 waa ... sababtoo ah ...
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma xaqiijisay in ururada xalka ee saddexda sinnaan la'aan dhammaantood ay kala duwan yihiin?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma bixisay sababta ah in labajibbaar uu yahay ugu yaraan 0 oo uu la simanyahay 0 kaliya marka x=3?
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.0: (x−3)² had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 0 oo wuxuu la simanyahay 0 kaliya marka x=3. Ee ≥ 0 waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah, ee > 0 waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah marka laga reebo x=3, ee < 0 na xal ma jiro.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.1: ≥0: dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah. >0: dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah leh x≠3. <0: xal ma jiro (urur madhan). Tani waa sababtoo ah labajibbaar ma noqon karo taban oo waa 0 kaliya marka x=3.
n-m-h1-ineq-06.s.s3.model.2: < 0 xal ma laha, > 0 waa dhammaan tirooyinka marka laga reebo 3, ≥ 0 na waa dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah. Sababtu waa (x−3)² ≥ 0, oo sinnaan ay jirto kaliya marka x=3.

n-m-h1-ineq-07.title: Hubinta xal ku saabsan xadka x − y
n-m-h1-ineq-07.goal: Hel qaladka xal helay xad adigoo ka jaraya laba sinnaan la'aan dhinac-dhinac, saxo adigoo isticmaalaya hab sax ah, oo kala saar goorta xisaabinta dhinac-dhinac la oggol yahay isku-darka, ka-jarista, iyo ku dhufashada.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.material: Sumin wuxuu helay "xadka x−y marka 1<x<3 iyo 2<y<5" sida hoos ku xusan.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.0: Hubinta haddii natiijada xalku macno leedahay
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.1: Saxitaanka adigoo isticmaalaya hawl beddesha calaamadaha
n-m-h1-ineq-07.thinking.2: Kala saarista goorta xisaabinta dhinac-dhinac la oggol yahay
n-m-h1-ineq-07.prereq.0: Sifooyinka aasaasiga ah ee sinnaan la'aanta (ku dhufashada labada dhinac tiro taban waxay rogtaa calaamadda sinnaan la'aanta)
n-m-h1-ineq-07.prereq.1: Sifada isku darista sinnaan la'aanta dhinac-dhinac
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee aan sax ahayn ee xalka Sumin.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi haddii sinnaan la'aanta natiijada ay macno leedahay, oo dib ugu raac jidka u horseeday.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Geli dhowr qiimo oo x iyo y ah oo ku habboon shuruudaha, xisaabi x − y, oo isbarbar dhig natiijada xalka.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.0: Hel xadka x − y marka 1 < x < 3 …① iyo 2 < y < 5 …②.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.1: Ka jarista ② ① dhinac-dhinac isla dhinacyada waxay siinaysaa 1 − 2 < x − y < 3 − 5.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.line.3: Sidaa darteed xadka x − y waa −1 < x − y < −2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa safka ugu horreeya ee aan sax ahayn. Sinnaan la'aanta isla jihada waa la isku dari karaa dhinac-dhinac laakiin looma jari karo. Intii y sii weynaato, x−y wuu sii yaraadaa, sidaa darteed dhammaadka sare 5 ee y waa inuu aadaa dhammaadka hoose ee x−y. Safafka 3 iyo 4 si fudud ayay u sii wadaan xisaabinta safka 2.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.prompt: Qor xadka saxda ah ee x − y oo sharax sida aad u heshay. Kadibna geli hal lammaane qiimayaal x iyo y ah oo ku habboon shuruudaha oo hubi in natiijadu xadka dhexdiisa tahay.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir sida loo helo xadka −y marka hore. Tiro kee ayaad ku dhufan kartaa sinnaan la'aanta y?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir qiimayaasha x iyo y ee u dhow marka x−y uu yahay kan ugu yar iyo marka uu yahay kan ugu weyn.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Maadaama ..., x−y wuu ka weyn yahay ... oo ka yar yahay .... Hubin: x=..., y=...
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday hal safar sida aad u heshay −4 iyo 1?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma gelisay qiimayaal ku habboon shuruudaha si aad u hubiso in natiijadu xadka dhexdiisa tahay?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa sababta ka-jaristu u shaqeyn weyso (intii y sii weynaato, x−y wuu sii yaraadaa)?
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.0: Ku dhufashada dhinac kasta oo ② −1 waxay rogtaa calaamadaha sinnaan la'aanta, taasoo siinaysa −5 < −y < −2. Ku darista ① dhinac-dhinac waxay siinaysaa 1−5 < x−y < 3−2, taasi waa, −4 < x−y < 1. Hubin: haddii x=2, y=3, markaas x−y=−1, taasoo xadka ku jirta.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.1: x−y waa kan ugu yar marka x yar yahay y na weyn yahay, sidaa darteed wuxuu u dhow yahay 1−5=−4, wuxuu na yahay kan ugu weyn marka x weyn yahay y na yar yahay, sidaa darteed wuxuu u dhow yahay 3−2=1. Sidaa darteed −4 < x−y < 1, haddii x=1.5, y=4 na, waa −2.5, taasoo xadka ku jirta.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s2.model.2: Adigoo u arkaya x−y sida x + (−y), hel xadka −y, −5 < −y < −2, oo ku dar si aad u hesho −4 < x−y < 1. Gelinta x=2.5, y=2.5 waxay siinaysaa 0, taasoo xadka ku jirta.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.prompt: Dooro dhammaan xaaladaha, ee a<x<b iyo c<y<d, aad dhinac-dhinac u xisaabin karto si aad u hesho xadka.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Doorasho kasta, dooro xad tirooyin gaar ah, dhinac-dhinac u xisaabi, oo isbarbar dhig natiijada qiimayaasha dhabta ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Samee xad ka kooban tirooyin taban oo hubi halka qiimaha ugu yar ee wax-ku-dhacu ka yimaado.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.a: Xadka xy marka xadadka x iyo y labaduba yihiin togan
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.b: Helitaanka xadka x − y adigoo ka jaraya isla dhinacyada dhinac-dhinac
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.b: Ka jarista isla dhinacyada dhinac-dhinac waxay siin kartaa tibaax is-diidmo ah sida −1<x−y<−2. Ka-jaris, waa inaad maraysaa hawl beddesha calaamadda.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.c: Helitaanka xadka x + y adigoo isku daraya isla dhinacyada dhinac-dhinac
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.o.d: Helitaanka xadka xy adigoo ku dhufanaya dhinac-dhinac calaamad kasta
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.r.d: Marka tirooyin taban la isku qaso, xadadka wax-ku-dhacu way beddelmaan. Tusaale ahaan, haddii −2<x<1 iyo 1<y<3, ku dhufashada dhinac-dhinac waxay siinaysaa −2<xy<3, laakiin x=−1.9, y=2.9, xy≈−5.5 waa ka baxsan.
n-m-h1-ineq-07.s.s3.explain: Isku-darka had iyo jeer waa suurtagal, ku dhufashada dhinac-dhinac na waa la oggol yahay kaliya marka dhammaan tirooyinka ay togan yihiin. Ka-jarista iyo ku dhufashada leh calaamado isku qasan, waa inaad beddesho calaamadaha ama aad u kala qaybiso xaalado oo aad baarto qiimayaasha xad-dhaafka ah.

n-m-h1-ineq-08.title: Maxaa kale oo loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo tirada ardayda?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.goal: Dhis nidaam sinnaan la'aan ah oo leh shuruud tiro dhan, marka ay jiraan dhowr qiime oo suurtagal ah, kala saar macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo hal iyo kan aan loo baahnayn.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan siino qalin-xaasha ardayda. Haddii aan qof kasta siino 4 qalin, 15 qalin ayaa hadha. Haddii aan mid kasta siino 7, ardaydii hore dhammaantood waxay helayaan 7 qalin mid mid, ardaygii ugu dambeeyana wuxuu helayaa ugu yaraan 1 qalin laakiin ma buuxiyo 7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.thinking.1: Isticmaalka shuruudda tiro dhan si loo helo dhammaan qiimayaasha suurtagalka ah
n-m-h1-ineq-08.prereq.1: Shuruudaha tirooyinka dhan iyo nidaamyada sinnaan la'aanta
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.prompt: Ha ahaato tirada ardayda n oo ku muuji wadarta tirada qalin-xaasha n. Deji sinnaan la'aan tirada qalin-xaasha ee ardaygii ugu dambeeyay helo, oo hel dhammaan qiimayaasha suurtagalka ah ee n.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ku muuji wadarta tirada qalin-xaasha n xaaladda halkaas oo 4 qof kasta la siiyo.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qor imisa arday ayaa helaya 7 qalin mid mid, ka jar qalin-xaasha ay heleen wadarta, oo ku muuji qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay tibaax ahaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.placeholder: tusaale, Waxaa jira ... qalin wadar ahaan, ardaygii ugu dambeeyayna wuxuu helayaa ... qalin, sidaa darteed ... ≤ n ≤ ...
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.selfAssess.0: Ma ku muujisay tirada qalin-xaasha sida 4n+15?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay shuruudda ah in qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay ay tahay ugu yaraan 1 oo ka yar 7 (ugu badnaan 6) sida sinnaan la'aan?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.selfAssess.2: Ma isticmaashay shuruudda ah in n uu yahay tiro dabiici ah?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.0: Waxaa jira 4n+15 qalin wadar ahaan. Ardaygii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu helayaa 4n+15−7(n−1)=22−3n qalin, 1≤22−3n≤6 na. Markaas 16/3≤n≤7, maadaama n uu yahay tiro dabiici ah, waxaa jira 6 ama 7 arday.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.1: Haddii tirada ardaydu tahay n, waxaa jira 4n+15 qalin. Waxaa jira n−1 arday oo helaya 7 mid mid, sidaa darteed qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay waa 22−3n, maadaama ay tahay ugu yaraan 1 iyo ugu badnaan 6, n waa 6 ama 7.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s1.model.2: Maadaama 4n+15 − 7(n−1) uu yahay ugu yaraan 1 iyo ugu badnaan 6, 22−3n wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 1 iyo 6. Maadaama n≤7 iyo n≥5.33..., n=6 ama 7 waa suurtagal.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.prompt: Dooro dhammaan macluumaadka go'aamiya u dhexeeya 6 arday iyo 7 arday. (Ka fikir macluumaad aad si cusub u barato, marka laga reebo wixii horey loo yaqaanay.)
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi wadarta tirada qalin-xaasha iyo qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay 6 arday iyo 7 arday, oo ku qor shax.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Shaxda, hel shayada leh qiimayaal kala duwan labada xaaladood.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.b: Xaqiiqda ah in siinta 4 mid kasta ay ka tagto 15
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.b: Tani waa macluumaad horey dhibaatada ugu jiray. Labadaba 6 iyo 7 arday waxay buuxiyaan shuruuddan.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.c: Xaqiiqda ah in qof kasta marka laga reebo kan ugu dambeeya uu helo 7 qalin
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.r.c: Tani waa xaqiiqo horey dhibaatada ugu jirtay. Waxay si siman u run tahay 6 iyo 7 arday labadaba, sidaa darteed ma kala saari karto.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.o.d: Tirada qalin-xaasha ee ardaygii ugu dambeeyay helo
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s2.explain: 6 arday, waxaa jira 39 qalin ardaygii ugu dambeeyayna wuxuu helayaa 4; 7 arday, waxaa jira 43 qalin ardaygii ugu dambeeyayna wuxuu helayaa 1. Ogaanshaha wadarta tirada ama qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay waxay ku go'aamisaa hal.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.prompt: Ka soo qaad inaad ogaatay in ardaygii ugu dambeeyay uu helay 4 qalin. Go'aamin tirada ardayda, oo hubi wadarta tirada qalin-xaasha shuruudaha labadaba.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Qor isla'egta aad hesho marka aad tibaaxda qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay ee n ka dhigto 4.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Xisaabi wadarta tirada qalin-xaasha adigoo isticmaalaya n aad heshay, oo mar kale hubi labada xaaladood ee siinta 7 mid kasta iyo 4 mid kasta.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.placeholder: tusaale, 22−3n=..., sidaa darteed n=... arday iyo ... qalin. Hubin: ...
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma go'aamisay tirada ardayda hal qiime?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay labada shuruudood tirooyin ahaan?
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.0: Qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay 22−3n=4, sidaa darteed n=6 arday. Qalin-xaasha: 4×6+15=39. Hubin: siinta 7 qalin 5 arday kasta waxay isticmaalaysaa 35, sidaa darteed ardaygii ugu dambeeyay wuxuu helayaa 4; siinta 4 mid kasta waxay isticmaalaysaa 24 oo waxay ka tagtaa 15.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.1: Waxaa jira 6 arday. Waxaa jira 39 qalin; 5 arday ayaa helaya 7 mid mid, 35, 4-ta hadhay na waa qaybta ardaygii ugu dambeeyay. Siinta 4 mid kasta 6 arday waxay ka tagtaa 15, sidaa darteed labada shuruudood way ku habboon yihiin.
n-m-h1-ineq-08.s.s3.model.2: Xallinta 22−3n=4 waxay siinaysaa n=6, sidaa darteed waxaa jira 6 arday iyo 39 qalin. Waan hubiyey: 7×5+4=39 iyo 4×6+15=39.

n-m-h1-ineq-09.title: |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3: Xal ma jiraa? Laba nooc oo caddayn ah
n-m-h1-ineq-09.goal: Isbarbar dhig hubin lagu sameeyey beddelidda dhowr qiimood iyo caddayn lagu sharaxay masaafada khadka tirooyinka, oo ku tarjun ururka xalka ee lagu sameeyey isugeynta qiimayaasha saafiga ah masaafo ahaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.material:
Laba arday mid walba wuxuu bixiyey caddayn ku saabsan haddii sinnaan la'aanta |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 3 ay leedahay xal.

Arin: Waxaan beddelay x = −1, 0, 1, 2, 3. Isugeynadu waa 4, 4, 4, 4, 4 si kala horreyn ah. Midna ma aha 3 ama ka yar, sidaa darteed xal ma jiro.

Dohyeon: |x+1| waa masaafada u dhexeysa x iyo −1 khadka tirooyinka, |x−3| na waa masaafada u dhexeysa x iyo 3. Masaafada u dhexeysa −1 iyo 3 waa 4, sidaa darteed meel kasta oo x ay joogto, isugeynta labada masaafo ma noqon karto ka yar 4. Sidaa darteed xal ma jiro.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.1: Akhrinta qiimaha saafiga ah sida masaafada khadka tirooyinka
n-m-h1-ineq-09.thinking.2: Tarjumidda ururka xalka ee calaamad sinnaan la'aan kale oo isla tibaaxda ah
n-m-h1-ineq-09.prereq.0: Macnaha qiimaha saafiga ah (masaafada u dhexeysa laba tiro khadka tirooyinka)
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xukunka saxda ah ee ku saabsan caddaynta labada arday.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir nooca tirooyinka qiimayaasha x ee Arin tijaabiyey ay yihiin, iyo imisa qiimood oo aan la tijaabin ayaa hadhay.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Tixgeli haddii sharaxaadda Dohyeon ay run tahay meel kasta oo x ay joogto, ama ay lagu isticmaali karo kaliya ka dib go'aaminta hal x.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.a: Caddaynta Arin oo keliya ayaa caddaynaysa in xal aanu jirin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.a: Beddelidda dhowr tiro dhan waa hubin oo keliya. Tirooyin dhab ah oo aan tiro lahayn ayaa weli aan la tijaabin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.b: Labada caddayn labaduba waxay caddeeyaan in xal aanu jirin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u malaysay in beddelidda shan qiimood ay sharxayso x kasta. Ee x ka baxsan qiimayaasha la hubiyey, weli ma ogin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.c: Caddaynta Dohyeon oo keliya ayaa caddaynaysa in xal aanu jirin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.o.d: Labada caddayn midna ma caddeeyo in xal aanu jirin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.r.d: Caddaynta Dohyeon, ee lagu sharaxay masaafo, waxay muujisaa in isugeynta ay tahay ugu yaraan 4 x kasta, sidaa darteed waa mid la gebi karo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s1.explain: Dohyeon wuxuu muujiyey in meel kasta oo x ay joogto, isugeynta labada masaafo ay tahay ugu yaraan 4, masaafada u dhexeysa −1 iyo 3. Tani waa sharaxaad tirooyinka dhabta ah x dhammaantood. Qiimayaasha Arin way sax yihiin, laakiin shan qiimood oo keliya ma kuu sheegi karaan x kale.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.prompt: Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno ururka xalka ee |x+1| + |x−3| ≤ 4 annagoo isticmaalaya habka Dohyeon. Dooro kan sax ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Calaamadee −1 iyo 3 khadka tirooyinka, oo isbarbar dhig waxa isugeynta labada masaafo ay tahay marka x uu saxda dhexda u yahay labada bar iyo marka x uu ka midig yahay 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.hint.1: U tarjun masaafo ahaan khadka tirooyinka sababta isugeynadu ugu wada ahaayeen isku mid shaxda Arin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.a: Labada dhammaad, −1 iyo 3, isugeyntu sidoo kale waa saxda 4, sidaa darteed waxay buuxiyaan "≤ 4." Waxaad seegtay xadka calaamadda sinnaan la'aanta ka kooban sinnaan.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.c: Maaha kaliya labada dhammaad ee isugeyntu tahay 4. Sida shaxda Arin, isugeyntu waa 4 tirooyinka dhexda ah sidoo kale.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad u qaadatay natiijada "≤ 3" ee dhibaatadii hore sida ay tahay. Haddii ay jiraan x isugeyntoodu tahay saxda 4, "≤ 4" waxay leedahay xal.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s2.explain: Haddii x uu u dhexeeyo −1 iyo 3 (oo ay ku jiraan labada dhammaad), isugeynta labada masaafo waa saxda 4, masaafada u dhexeysa labada bar. Dibadeeda, wuu ka weyn yahay 4. Sidaa darteed ururka xalku waa −1 ≤ x ≤ 3.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.prompt: Qor isbarbar dhig sababta habka Arin (beddelidda qiimayaasha) uu u caddayn kari waayo "xal ma jiro," iyo sababta habka Dohyeon uu u caddayn karo.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Isbarbar dhig tirada qiimayaasha Arin hubiyey iyo tirada dhammaan tirooyinka dhabta ah.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Eeg haddii doodda masaafada Dohyeon isticmaalay lagu dabaqi karo xataa marka x aan la go'aamin.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.placeholder: tusaale, Arin wuxuu hubiyey kaliya ..., sidaa darteed ..., Dohyeon na ..., sidaa darteed ...
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma tilmaantay in ay jiraan x ka baxsan qiimayaasha la hubiyey?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay sababta caddaynta Dohyeon ay u run tahay x kasta?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ku xidhay xaqiiqda ah in isla fikraddaas ay akhrin karto ururka xalka ee ≤ 4?
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.0: Arin wuxuu beddelay shan tiro dhan oo keliya, sidaa darteed ma hubin karin tirooyinka dhexda ah ama x xadad kale. Dohyeon wuxuu muujiyey in maadaama masaafada u dhexeysa −1 iyo 3 khadka tirooyinka ay tahay 4, isugeynta labada masaafo had iyo jeer ay tahay ugu yaraan 4, tanina waxay quseysaa tiro dhab ah x kasta.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.1: Shaxdu waxay eegtaa dhowr qiime x oo keliya, sidaa darteed tirooyin dhab ah oo kale ayaa hadha (tusaale, 0.5, 100). Marka lagu fikiro masaafo, isugeyntu had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 4, sidaa darteed waa la caddeeyey in xal aanu jirin x kasta.
n-m-h1-ineq-09.s.s3.model.2: Beddelidda dhowr qiimood maaha caddayn. Haddii, sida Dohyeon, aad tiraahdo isugeynta labada masaafo ay tahay ugu yaraan masaafada u dhexeysa labada bar, 4, waxay isla markiiba sharxaysaa x kasta.

n-m-h1-geo-01.title: Hubinta xal ku saabsan masaafada u dhexeysa laba xariiq oo is-barbar socda
n-m-h1-geo-01.goal: Xal isticmaalaya qaacidada masaafada u dhexeysa laba xariiq oo is-barbar socda, hel oo saxo safka ugu horreeya ee qaldan, oo ku hubi adigoo isticmaalaya masaafada bar ilaa xariiq.
n-m-h1-geo-01.material: Hoos waxaa ah xalka Seojin ee masaafada u dhexeysa xariiqyada x+2y−3=0 iyo 2x+4y+8=0. (Akhri x² sida "x labajibbaaran," √5 sida "xidid 5," −3 na sida "taban 3.")
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.0: Helitaanka safka ugu horreeya ee qaldan ee xalka
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.1: Hubinta shuruudda ay qaacidadu run u tahay
n-m-h1-geo-01.thinking.2: Hubinta adigoo isticmaalaya hab kale (masaafada bar ilaa xariiq)
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka ugu horreeya ee xalka Seojin ee qaldan.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.0: Eeg waxa ay yihiin tirooyinka x iyo y hortooda ku jira labada isla'eg ee ka muuqda qaacidada safka 2.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tijaabi shuruuddaas labada xariiq ee Seojin qoray, mid mid.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.0: Labada xariiq x+2y−3=0 iyo 2x+4y+8=0 waxay leeyihiin isla jiheyn, sidaa darteed waa is-barbar socdaan.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.1: Masaafada u dhexeysa xariiqyada is-barbar socda ax+by+c₁=0 iyo ax+by+c₂=0 waa |c₁−c₂|/√(a²+b²).
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.line.2: Xariiqda koowaad a=1, b=2, c₁=−3, xariiqda labaad na c₂=8.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s1.explain: Wuxuu ka qaldamay safka 3. Qaacidada safka 2 waxaa la isticmaali karaa kaliya marka isu-dheelitirrada x iyo y ee labada isla'eg ay isku mid yihiin, laakiin xariiqda labaad waxay leedahay isu-dheelitirro 2 iyo 4 x iyo y, kuwaas oo ka duwan xariiqda koowaad, 8 na waa ereyga joogtada ah ee isla'egtaas. Safka 4 waa xisaabin raacda safka 3, sidaa darteed qiimihiisu waa qalad. U qaybinta isla'egta labaad 2 waxay siinaysaa x+2y+4=0, masaafaduna waa |−3−4|/√5=7/√5.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.prompt: Saxo qaybta qaldan oo hel masaafada u dhexeysa labada xariiq. Kadibna sidoo kale dooro hal bar xariiqda koowaad ku taal, si gooni ah u xisaabi masaafadeeda xariiqda labaad, oo qor haddii aad hesho isla qiime.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir sida aad isla'egta labaad u beddeli karto si qaacidada loo isticmaali karo.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro bar xariiqda koowaad ku taal oo si gooni ah u qor qaacidada masaafada bar ilaa xariiq.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, Beddelidda isla'egta labaad ilaa ... waxay siinaysaa ..., sidaa darteed masaafadu waa ...
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ka dhigtay isu-dheelitirrada xariiqda labaad mid la mid ah xariiqda koowaad, kadibna isbarbar dhigtay ereyada joogtada ah?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma dooratay bar oo hubisay in qiimaha habka kale uu la simanyahay qiimaha koowaad?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa shuruudda waa in la hubiyo ka hor isticmaalka qaacidada?
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.model.0: U qaybinta isla'egta labaad 2 waxay siinaysaa x+2y+4=0, sidaa darteed isu-dheelitirrada x iyo y waxay noqdaan kuwo la mid ah xariiqda koowaad. Markaas masaafadu waa |−3−4|/√5=7/√5. Hubin: masaafada laga bilaabo barta (3,0) ee xariiqda koowaad ku taal ilaa 2x+4y+8=0 waa |6+8|/√20=14/(2√5)=7/√5, isku mid.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.model.1: Si loo waafajiyo isu-dheelitirrada, waxaan isla'egta labaad ka jaray badh oo waxaan qornaa x+2y+4=0. Masaafadu waa 7√5/5, qiyaastii 3.13. Xisaabinta masaafada 14/√20 laga bilaabo (3,0) ilaa xariiqda labaad waxay siinaysaa isla qiime.
n-m-h1-geo-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Xal isticmaalaya kaliya masaafada bar iyo xariiq sidoo kale waa sax haddii uu siiyo isla qiime.

n-m-h1-geo-03.title: U rar oo ka muuqaal: maxaa dhici lahaa haddii aan kala horreynta is-bedelno?
n-m-h1-geo-03.goal: Ku hubi tusaale in isku-darka u rarid iyo muuqaal uu siin karo natiijooyin kala duwan marka kala horreynta la is-bedelo, oo isla'eg ku hel shuruudda hoostooda is-bedelka kala horreynta uu siinayo isla natiijo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.material: Bar P oo dusha isku-xidhka ku taal waxaa lagu dhaqaajiyey laba isbeddel. Isbeddelka T waa u rarid m jihada x iyo n jihada y, isbeddelka S na waa muuqaalka fooska x. Waxaad isbarbar dhigi doontaa "T kadibna S" iyo "S kadibna T."
n-m-h1-geo-03.thinking.0: Samaynta saadaalin iyo hubinta adigoo xisaabinaya
n-m-h1-geo-03.thinking.1: U beddelidda hal tusaale isla'eg guud
n-m-h1-geo-03.prereq.1: Muuqaalka fooska x iyo fooska y
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.prompt: Dib u eeg saadaalintaada mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub la muujiyo oo ku saabsan waxa dhaca marka kala horreynta la is-bedelo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore si gooni ah u xisaabi labada kala horreyn oo qor isku-xidhayaasha barta.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg qaybta u rarida ee la xiriirta isku-xidhka calaamaddiisa is beddelaysa muuqaalka hoostiisa.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Ka soo qaad u rarida (+1,+4) iyo muuqaalka fooska x oo lagu dabaqay barta P(3,2) laba kala horreyn oo kala duwan, taasoo siinaysa labada bar P₁ iyo P₂.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma u malaynaysaa P₁ iyo P₂ inay isla bar yihiin?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Aan si toos ah u xisaabinno. U rarid marka hore: (3,2)→(4,6)→(4,−6). Muuqaal marka hore: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(4,2). Labada bar way kala duwan yihiin.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waxaan u malaynayaa inay had iyo jeer isku mid yihiin (kala horreyntu muhiim ma aha).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waxaan u malaynayaa inay kala duwanaan karaan.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ma ogaan karo ilaa aan xisaabiyo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Markan, u beddel u rarida (+5,0). Barta waa weli P(3,2).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Natiijooyinka labada kala horreyn ma kala duwanaan doonaan markan sidoo kale?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.after: U rarid marka hore: (3,2)→(8,2)→(8,−2). Muuqaal marka hore: (3,2)→(3,−2)→(8,−2). Markan waa isku mid. Waxa beddelay waa in cadadka dhaqdhaqaaqa kor uu ahaa 0.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waxaan u malaynayaa weli inay kala duwanaan doonaan.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Waxaan u malaynayaa inay isku mid noqon doonaan markan.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Waxaan rabnaa inaan helno u rarid kuwaas oo is-bedelka kala horreynta uu siinayo isla natiijo. Musharaxiintu waa (2,3), (4,0), (0,5), (0,0).
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kee ka mid ah kuwan ayaa siinaya isla natiijo bar kasta marka kala horreynta la is-bedelo?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Muuqaalka fooska x wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda isku-xidhka y, sidaa darteed dhaqdhaqaaqa jihada y waa inuu noqdaa 0. (4,0) iyo (0,0) waxay buuxiyaan tan, (0,0) na waa u rarida aan waxba dhaqaajin.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s1.reflect: Haddii aad isbarbar dhigto sababta natiijooyinku ugu kala duwanaadeen hal tusaale oo ay ugu waafaqeen kan kale, waxaad arki kartaa in haddii kala horreynta isbeddelada ay muhiim tahay ay ku xiran tahay "waxa la dhaqaajinayo." Ka hor intaadan go'aamin "had iyo jeer isku mid/kala duwan" hal ama laba xisaabin, waa inaad ku hubisaa isla'eg.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.prompt: Qor sida isla'egyo natiijooyinka dabaqidda "T kadibna S" iyo "S kadibna T" barta (x,y), oo qor shuruudda m iyo n si labada natiijo ay u siman yihiin.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kala horreyn kasta, qor isku-xidhayaasha dhexe tallaabo tallaabo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.hint.1: Si gooni ah u isbarbar dhig isku-xidhayaasha x iyo y ee labada bar ee ugu dambeeya.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.placeholder: tusaale, T kadibna S wuxuu siinayaa ..., S kadibna T wuxuu siinayaa ..., si ay siman u noqdaan ...
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay tibaaxda isku-xidhka y noqdo labada kala horreyn mid walba?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma xaqiijisay in qiimaha m uusan saameynin shuruudda?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma isku xidhay tusaalayaasha tirooyinka ee kor ku xusan iyo isla'egyada guud?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.0: T kadibna S: (x,y)→(x+m,y+n)→(x+m,−y−n). S kadibna T: (x,y)→(x,−y)→(x+m,−y+n). Si isku-xidhayaasha y −y−n iyo −y+n ay u siman yihiin, n waa inuu ahaadaa 0. m wuxuu noqon karaa qiime kasta.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s2.model.1: Haddii aad marka hore muuqaasho waxaad heleysaa (x+m, n−y), haddii aad marka hore u rartid na waxaad heleysaa (x+m, −y−n). Si isku-xidhayaasha y ay u siman yihiin, n=−n, sidaa darteed kaliya marka n uu yahay 0. Haddii aad si siman oo keliya u dhaqaajiso, is-bedelka kala horreynta wuxuu siinayaa isla natiijo.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.prompt: Markan, ka soo qaad inaan isticmaalno muuqaalka fooska y halkii aan S isticmaali lahayn. Maxaa loo baahan yahay u rarida (m,n) iyo muuqaalka fooska y si ay u siiyaan isla natiijo marka kala horreynta la is-bedelo?
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.0: Markan, marka hore go'aamin isku-xidhka kee ayaa beddela calaamadda.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig isku-xidhayaasha natiijada ee labada kala horreyn isla sida tallaabadii hore.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad natiijada muuqaalka fooska x si toos ah ugu qaadatay muuqaalka fooska y. Mar kale hubi isku-xidhka kee ayaa beddela calaamadda.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.o.c: Had iyo jeer waa isku mid m iyo n kasta.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.c: Muuqaal wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda hal isku-xidhe, sidaa darteed dhaqdhaqaaqa jihada isku-xidhkaas wuxuu saameeyaa kala horreynta.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.r.d: Isbarbar dhigga cabbirrada cadadka u rarida muhiim ma aha.
n-m-h1-geo-03.s.s3.explain: Muuqaalka fooska y wuxuu beddelaa calaamadda isku-xidhka x. U rarida (x+m, y+n) kadibna muuqaal waxay siinaysaa (−x−m, y+n), muuqaal kadibna u rarid na waxay siinaysaa (−x+m, y+n), sidaa darteed waa siman yihiin kaliya marka m=0.

n-m-h1-geo-04.title: Hubinta xal ku saabsan bar laga muuqaaleeyey xariiq
n-m-h1-geo-04.goal: Xal helaya muuqaalka bar ee xariiq, hel oo saxo safka ugu horreeya ee qaldan, oo xukun hubin kee ayaa qabata jawaab qaldan.
n-m-h1-geo-04.material: Kani waa xalka Doyun ee helitaanka isku-xidhayaasha barta B, muuqaalka barta A(5,0) ee xariiqda y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.1: Si sax ah u beddelida shuruudaha (bar dhexe, toosan) isla'egyo
n-m-h1-geo-04.thinking.2: Isbarbar dhigga haddii habka hubinta uu qabto qaladka
n-m-h1-geo-04.prereq.0: Wax-ku-dhaca jiheynta marka laba xariiq ay toosan yihiin
n-m-h1-geo-04.prereq.1: Isku-xidhayaasha barta dhexe ee qayb xariiq ah
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee xalka Doyun ee khaldamay.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.0: Xusuuso xiriirka u dhexeeya janjeeraha laba xariiq oo is-taagan.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ku dhufo janjeeraha safka 3 janjeeraha xariiqda y=2x oo hubi haddii xiriirkaas run yahay.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqoto barta aan rabno B(p,q).
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.1: Barta dhexe ((5+p)/2, q/2) ee gabal AB waxay saran tahay xariiqda y=2x, sidaas darteed q/2=2·(5+p)/2, taasi waa, q=2p+10.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.2: Xariiqda AB waxay is-taagan tahay xariiqda y=2x, sidaas darteed janjeeraha AB waa −2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.line.4: Xallinta labada isla'eg wadajir waxay siinaysaa p=0, q=10, sidaas darteed B(0,10).
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s1.explain: Waxay ku khaldantay safka 3. Haddii laba xariiq is-taagan yihiin, wax-isku-dhufashada janjeerahooda waa −1, sidaas darteed si wax-isku-dhufashada janjeeraha 2 ee y=2x uu u noqdo −1, janjeeraha AB waa inuu noqdaa −1/2. Ma beddeli kartid calaamadda oo keliya. Safafka 4 iyo 5 waxay ka yimaadaan safka 3.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.prompt: Saxo safka khaldan oo hel isku-duwayaasha barta la milaay B. Sidoo kale qor janjeerahee la isticmaalayo.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qor janjeeraha xariiqda y=2x oo hel lambarka ku dhufanaya si uu u siiyo −1.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.hint.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya janjeeraha, dhis xiriir cusub oo u dhexeeya q iyo p, oo ku wada xalli isla'egta ka timaadda shuruudda barta dhexe.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Maadaama ay is-taagan yihiin, janjeeraha AB waa ..., xallinta wadajirna waxay siinaysaa ...
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay si sax ah shuruudda is-taagnaanta sida wax-isku-dhufashada janjeerayaasha = −1?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma hubisay in barta aad heshay ay buuxinayso labada shuruudood ee barta dhexe iyo is-taagnaanta?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sheegi kartaa shuruudda barta Doyun (0,10) ay jebinayso?
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.0: Haddii ay is-taagan yihiin, wax-isku-dhufashada janjeerayaasha waa −1, sidaas darteed janjeeraha 2 ee y=2x, janjeeraha AB waa inuu noqdaa −1/2. Laga bilaabo q/(p−5)=−1/2 waxaan helnaa p+2q=5, xallinta wadajir iyo q=2p+10 na waxay siinaysaa p=−3, q=4. Barta la milaay waa (−3,4), barta dhexe (1,2) na waxay saran tahay y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s2.model.1: Qorista janjeeraha sida −2 waxay ahayd khalad. Haddii ay is-taagan yihiin, wax-isku-dhufashadu waa −1, sidaas darteed janjeeraha AB waa −1/2. Xallinta sidaas waxay siinaysaa B(−3,4). Hubin: barta dhexe (1,2) waxay saran tahay y=2x, janjeeraha AB na waa 4/(−8)=−1/2.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.prompt: Hubinta kee ayaa muujinaysa in jawaabta Doyun (0,10) ay khaldan tahay? (Barta Doyun waxay buuxisaa shuruudda barta dhexe ee Doyun dejiyey.)
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.0: Hubin kasta si toos ah ugu dabaq barta Doyun (0,10) oo eeg haddii ay ka gudubto.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.hint.1: Sheeg shuruudda hubinta ku guuldareysata ay tijaabinayso.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.a: Hubi haddii barta dhexe ee gabal AB ay saran tahay xariiqda y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.a: Barta Doyun waxaa laga dhisay shuruuddan, sidaas darteed hubintani mar walba way ka gudubtaa. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad hubiso shuruud kale.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.b: Hubi haddii masaafooyinka laga bilaabo A iyo laga bilaabo B ilaa xariiqda y=2x ay siman yihiin.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.b: Qiimahani labada bar waa isku mid, laakiin barta Doyun sidoo kale way ka gudubtaa (labaduba waa 2√5). Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad si gooni ah u eegto jihada xariiqda AB.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.c: Hubi haddii jihada xariiqda AB ay is-taagan tahay xariiqda y=2x.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.o.d: Hubi haddii B ay tahay bar ka duwan A.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.r.d: (0,10) waa bar ka duwan A, sidaas darteed hubintani waxba ma saarto.
n-m-h1-geo-04.s.s3.explain: Ee (0,10), barta dhexe (2.5,5) waxay saran tahay y=2x, masaafooyinka laga bilaabo A iyo B ilaa xariiqdana labaduba waa 2√5, siman, sidaas darteed a iyo b way ka gudbaan. Laakiin vector-ka jihada AB, (−5,10), iyo jihada xariiqda, (1,2), waxay siinayaan (−5)·1+10·2=15≠0, sidaas darteed ma is-taagna. Barta la milaay waa inay buuxisaa labadaba "barta dhexe waxay saran tahay xariiqda" iyo "xariiqda AB waxay is-taagan tahay xariiqda."

n-m-h1-geo-06.title: Ka jarista Isla'egaha Laba Goobo Waxay Siisay Xariiq
n-m-h1-geo-06.goal: Xukun sheegashada ah in xariiqda laga helo ka jarista isla'egaha laba goobo ay ka gudubto baraha goobuhu ku kulmaan, oo qor sida loo hubiyo haddii runtii ay kulmaan.
n-m-h1-geo-06.material: Seoa wuxuu dhinac dhinac uga jaray isla'egaha labada goobo x²+y²=4 iyo (x−5)²+y²=4 si uu u helo 10x−25=0, taasi waa, x=5/2, wuxuuna qoray, "Labada goobo waxay ku kulmaan baro xariiqda x=5/2 saran."
n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.0: Kala saarista natiijada isla'egaha iyo jiritaanka dhabta ah
n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.1: Hubinta ku qasidda shuruudaha lagama maarmaanka ah iyo kuwa ku filan
n-m-h1-geo-06.thinking.2: Xukunka booska isku-xidhka isticmaalaya masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha iyo radiyaha
n-m-h1-geo-06.prereq.1: Booska isku-xidhka ee laba goobo (masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha iyo radiyaha)
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.prompt: Sidee u xukumi lahayd gabagabada Seoa, "Labada goobo waxay ku kulmaan baro xariiqda x=5/2 saran"?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.0: Beddel x=5/2 mid ka mid ah labada isla'eg ee asalka ah.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir halka labada goobo runtii yaalaan, adigoo isticmaalaya xarumahooda iyo radiyahooda.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.a: Sax. Xariiqda waxay ka timid ka jarista isla'egaha, sidaas darteed baraha isgoysku waxay saran yihiin xariiqdaas.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ka tagtay in xariiqda laga helo ka jarista ay tahay kaliya "halka baraha isgoysku ay noqon lahaayeen, haddii goobuhu kulmaan."
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.b: Sax. Labada goobo waxay leeyihiin radiyo isku mid ah, sidaas darteed mar walba way kulmaan.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.b: Xitaa radiyo isku mid ah, goobuhu ma kulmaan haddii xarumahoodu fogaadaan.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.c: Ma sax aha. Waxaan helnay xariiq, laakiin in labada goobo runtii ay kulmaan waa in si gooni ah loo hubiyo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.o.d: Ma sax aha. Waa inaadan ka jarin isla'egaha laba goobo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka jarista isla'egaha waa xisaab ansax ah. Dhibaatadu waxay ku jirtaa sida natiijada loo fasiro.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s1.explain: Beddelka x=5/2 isla'egta goobada waxay siinaysaa y²=4−25/4<0, sidaas darteed y dhab ah ma jiro. Masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha, 5, way ka weyn tahay wadarta radiyaha, 4, sidaas darteed labada goobo ma kulmaan. Xariiqda laga helo ka jarista isla'egaha macnaheedu waa kaliya "haddii ay kulmaan, baraha isgoysku waxay saran yihiin xariiqdan."
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.prompt: Qor ugu yaraan hal hab oo lagu hubiyo haddii labada goobo ay kulmaan, oo qor natiijada uu siinayo marka dhibaatadan lagu dabaqo.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.hint.0: Eeg isla'egta y ee aad hesho marka aad qiimaha x ee laga helay ka jarista ku beddesho isla'egta asalka ah.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.hint.1: Qor xarunta iyo radiyaha goobo kasta oo barbar dhig masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Beddelka x=5/2 waxay siinaysaa ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma isku dayday inaad xariiqda laga helay ka jarista ku beddesho isla'egta goobada?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma barbar dhigtay masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha, 5, iyo wadarta radiyaha, 4?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma sharaxi kartaa in "waxaan helnay xariiq" iyo "bar isgoys ah ayaa jirta" ay macno kala duwan leeyihiin?
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s2.model.0: Beddelka x=5/2 ee x²+y²=4 waxay siinaysaa y²=4−25/4=−9/4, taasoo taban, sidaas darteed y dhab ah ma jiro. Sidaas darteed baro isgoys ma jiraan labada goobo na ma kulmaan. Masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha, 5, oo ka weyn wadarta radiyaha, 4, waxay u horseedaysaa isla gabagabada.

n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.prompt: Ka soo qaad inaad xariiq ka hesho ka jarista oo aad sidoo kale hubiso. Dooro dhammaan lammaanayaasha goobo ee soo socda ee leh ugu yaraan hal bar oo guud.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.hint.0: Hel masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha lammaane kasta.
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig masaafada iyo wadarta iyo farqiga radiyaha.

n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.r.c: Goobada yar gebi ahaanba waxay ku jirtaa goobada weyn gudaheeda (masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha 1 < farqiga radiyaha 3).
n-m-h1-geo-06.s.s3.explain: a: Masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha, 4, waxay u dhexeysaa farqiga radiyaha, 1, iyo wadarta, 5, sidaas darteed waxay ku kulmaan laba bar. d: Masaafada u dhexeysa xarumaha, 1, waxay le'eg tahay farqiga radiyaha, 1, sidaas darteed waxay taabanayaan hal bar (2,0). Ee b, masaafada 3 way ka weyn tahay wadarta 2, ee c na masaafada 1 way ka yar tahay farqiga 3, sidaas darteed bar guud ma laha.

n-m-h1-geo-07.title: Sharaxidda Isla'egta Xariiqda Taabata Iyadoo Aan Qaacidada La Isticmaalin
n-m-h1-geo-07.goal: Saaxiib kaliya isticmaala qaacidada xariiqda taabata ee barta goobo saran, mar kale u sharax sababta isla'egta xariiqda taabata u soo baxdo, adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqda ah in taabaha uu is-taagan yahay radiyaha.
n-m-h1-geo-07.material: Harin waxay xasuusatay oo keliya natiijada qaacidada, "xariiqda taabata goobada x²+y²=25 ee barta (3,4) waa 3x+4y=25." Waxay rabtaa inay u sharaxdo saaxiibkeed Jiho, kaasoo weydiiyey sababta. (Akhri x² sida "x labajibbaaran.")
n-m-h1-geo-07.thinking.1: Dib u qorista isla nuxurka heerka dhagaystaha
n-m-h1-geo-07.thinking.2: Hubinta shuruudda (barta waxay saran tahay goobada) sida aasaas
n-m-h1-geo-07.prereq.0: Xiriirka u dhexeeya xariiqda taabata iyo radiyaha goobo
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay xaqiiqda ugu muhiimsan ee lagu sharaxo sababta isla'egta xariiqda taabata ay u sax tahay?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sawir gabalka isku xidhaya barta taabashada (3,4) iyo xarunta (0,0), iyo xariiqda taabata, hal sawir.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir xagalka ay tahay in xariiqda taabata la sameyso gabalkan si aysan goobada gudaheeda u gelin.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.a: Xariiqda taabata waa xariiqda ugu fog xarunta goobada.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.a: Xariiqda taabata waa xariiq ku kulanta goobada hal bar; ma aha xariiqda ugu fog xarunta (waxaa jira xariiqyo masaafo aan dhammaad lahayn ah).
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.b: Xariiqda taabata waxay ka gudubtaa barta dhexe ee gabalka isku xidhaya barta taabashada iyo asalka.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.b: Xariiqda taabata ee barta taabashada waxay ka gudubtaa barta taabashada. Barta dhexe ma saarna xariiqda taabata.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.c: Xariiqda taabata waxay leedahay janjeer isku mid ah xariiqda isku xidhaysa barta taabashada iyo asalka.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.r.c: Xariiqda isku xidhaysa barta taabashada iyo asalka waa xariiqda ka kooban radiyaha, taabuhuna wuu is-taagan yahay. Haddii janjeerayaashu isku mid ahaan lahaayeen, taabuhu wuxuu ka gudbi lahaa goobada gudaheeda.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.o.d: Xariiqda taabata waxay is-taagan tahay radiyaha barta taabashada.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s1.explain: Xariiqda taabata goobada waxay is-taagan tahay radiyaha barta taabashada. Janjeeraha radiyuhu waa 4/3, sidaas darteed janjeeraha taabuhu waa −3/4, fududaynta xariiqda ka gudubta barta (3,4) na waxay siinaysaa 3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.prompt: Noqo Harin oo u sharax Jiho 3 ilaa 4 weedhood. Ha isticmaalin qaacidada; qor sida 3x+4y=25 u soo baxdo adigoo isticmaalaya janjeeraha radiyaha iyo janjeeraha xariiqda taabata.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel janjeeraha gabalka isku xidhaya barta taabashada iyo xarunta.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal xiriirka u dhexeeya janjeerayaasha xariiqyada is-taagan si aad u hesho janjeeraha taabaha, ka dibna qor isla'egta adigoo isticmaalaya bar iyo janjeer.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Janjeeraha radiyaha isku xidha xarunta (0,0) ee goobada iyo barta taabashada (3,4) waa ...
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sharaxday adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqooyin joomatari ah qaacidada la'aanteed?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma qortay sida aad uga gashay janjeeraha radiyaha ilaa janjeeraha xariiqda taabata?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma iska ilaaliyay erayada saaxiibkaa aanu aqoon?
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.model.0: Janjeeraha radiyaha isku xidha xarunta (0,0) iyo barta taabashada (3,4) waa 4/3. Xariiqda taabata waxay is-taagan tahay radiyaha barta taabashada, sidaas darteed janjeerahaedu waa −3/4. Fududaynta xariiqda leh janjeer −3/4 ee ka gudubta barta (3,4) waxay siinaysaa 3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s2.model.1: Jiho, xariiqda taabata waxay ku kulantaa radiyaha xagal toosan barta taabashada. Janjeeraha radiyuhu waa afar saddex-meelood, sidaas darteed janjeeraha taabuhu waa taban saddex afar-meelood. Fududaynta y−4=−(3/4)(x−3) waxay siinaysaa 3x+4y=25.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.prompt: Aan hubinno haddii sharaxaaddani u shaqeyso goobo kale sidoo kale. Goobada x²+y²=r² (r waa lambar dhan oo 1 ilaa 13), dooro bar lambar dhan ah (a,b) oo labada isku-duwe aanay eber ahayn, oo samee xariiqda taabata ax+by=r². Qor 4 (a, b, r) oo kala duwan.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.hint.0: Qor masaafada laga bilaabo asalka ilaa xariiqda ax+by=r² marka loo eego a, b, r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.hint.1: Shaqee qiimaha a²+b² ay tahay inuu yeesho si masaafadu u le'eg tahay radiyaha r.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.ok.k1: Dhammaantood waa tirooyin dhan baaxadda la oggol yahay gudaheeda, a iyo b-na ma aha 0.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k1: r waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 13, a iyo b-na waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan aan eber ahayn.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.ok.k2: Barta waxay ku taal goobada x²+y²=r².
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k2: Barta ma ku taal goobada. Barta halkan, isla'egta xariiqda taabata sidan lama qorin.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.ok.k3: Xariiqda ax+by=r² waa masaafada r ka fog asalka.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.fail.k3: Xariiqda ax+by=r² ma aha masaafada r ka fog asalka.
n-m-h1-geo-07.s.s3.explain: Masaafada u dhexeysa xariiqda ax+by=r² iyo asalka waa r²/√(a²+b²), si ay u noqoto xariiq taabata waa inay la mid noqotaa garab-dhexaadka r. Markaas a²+b²=r², taas oo ah, barta (a,b) waa inay ku taal goobada. tusaale, (3,4,5), (6,8,10), (5,12,13).

n-m-h1-geo-08.title: Saddex jawaab oo ku saabsan xariiq muuqaal-rogid: ma hal bar ayaa kala saari karta?
n-m-h1-geo-08.goal: Si loo doorto kan saxda ah ee xariiqyada kala duwan ee saddex arday bixiyeen, muuqaal-rog hal bar si aad u hubiso, oo xukun haddii hubintaasi ay tahay caddayn ku filan.
n-m-h1-geo-08.material: Saddex arday ayaa helay jawaabo kala duwan xariiqda laga helo muuqaal-rogidda xariiqda 2x+y=3 ee ku saabsan xariiqda y=−x. Minsu wuxuu helay x+2y+3=0, Jia wuxuu helay x+2y−3=0, Hajun-na wuxuu helay 2x+y+3=0. Saddexdu waxay go'aansadeen inay hubiyaan haddii barta (1,1) ee xariiqda asalka ah, taas oo noqonaysa (−1,−1) ka dib muuqaal-rogidda, ay ku taal xariiqda cusub.
n-m-h1-geo-08.thinking.0: Kala saarista waxa hubintu sifeyso iyo waxa aysan sifayn karin
n-m-h1-geo-08.prereq.1: Shuruudda ay bar ku taal xariiq
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan ardayda xariiqdoodu ka gudubto barta (−1,−1).
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.hint.0: Ku beddel x=−1, y=−1 isla'egta arday kasta oo xisaabi haddii ay la mid tahay 0.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.r.b: Bedelidda (−1,−1) waxay siinaysaa −1−2−3=−6≠0, sidaas darteed ma gudbo.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.r.d: Si toos ah u geli (−1,−1) isla'eg kasta oo xisaabi.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s1.explain: Minsu: −1−2+3=0 iyo Hajun: −2−1+3=0, sidaas darteed labaduba way ka gudbaan. Jia wuxuu siinayaa −6, sidaas darteed ma gudbo.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.prompt: Maxay macnaheedu tahay in barta (−1,−1) ay ku taal xariiqda arday?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir haddii laba xariiq oo kala duwan ay ka gudbi karaan isla bar.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ka fikir haddii hal barta taasi ay go'aamiso xariiqda.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.a: Ka gudbista barta ma ka dhigto mid sax ah; waa caddayn oo keliya oo aan ku filnayn in lagu yiraahdo waa khalad.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.b: Haddii ay ka gudubto barta, taasi waxay caddaynaysaa in xariiqda muuqaal-rogidda ay sax tahay.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.r.b: Xariiqyo aan dhammaad lahayn ayaa ka gudba hal bar, sidaas darteed xariiqyo kala duwan ayaa ka gudbi kara isla bar. Ka gudbista oo keliya ma ka dhigto xariiq sax ah.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.o.c: Xariiqyada ka gudba barta dhexdooda, hubintan oo keliya ayaa kala soocda midka saxda ah.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.r.c: Haddii dhowr xariiq ay ka gudbaan isla bar, hubintan ma kala saari karto.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s2.explain: Ka gudbista hubinta ma ka dhigto mid sax ah. Hal bar waxay u ogolaan kartaa xariiqyo musharax ah oo badan (xariiqyo aan dhammaad lahayn ayaa ka gudba hal bar). Si loo go'aamiyo xariiq, waxaad u baahan tahay laba bar oo kala duwan.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.prompt: Dooro bar kale oo ku taal xariiqda asalka ah 2x+y=3 marka laga reebo (1,1) oo hel muuqaal-rogideeda y=−x. Hubi xariiqda arday kee ayay barta taasi ku taal, oo qor kuwee xariiq ayaa sax ah.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.hint.0: Hel hal bar oo kale oo buuxisa 2x+y=3 (isku day x=0).
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.hint.1: Hel muuqaal-rogidda barta taas oo geli isla'egaha Minsu iyo Hajun.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.placeholder: tusaale, Haddii aan qaado barta (0,3), barta muuqaal-rogidda ahi waa ...
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma heshay muuqaal-rogidda barta taas adigoo isticmaalaya (x,y)→(−y,−x)?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ma ku muujisay xisaab in barta ay ku taal hal xariiq oo keliya?
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.model.0: Anigoo qaadanaya barta (0,3) ee xariiqda, muuqaal-rogideeda y=−x waa (−3,0). Bedelidda x+2y+3=0 ee Minsu waxay siinaysaa −3+3=0, sidaas darteed way ka gudubtaa, laakiin 2x+y+3=0 ee Hajun waxaan helnaa −6+3≠0, sidaas darteed ma gudubto. Sidaas darteed Minsu waa sax.
n-m-h1-geo-08.s.s3.model.1: Haddii aad doorato barta (2,−1), muuqaal-rogideeda waa (1,−2). Isla'egta Minsu waxay siinaysaa 1−4+3=0, sidaas darteed way gudubtaa, kan Hajun-na wuxuu siinayaa 2−2+3=3, sidaas darteed ma gudubto. Xariiqda Hajun waa khalad xariiqda Minsu-na waa sax.

n-m-h1-logic-01.title: Helitaanka safka ugu horreeya ee qaldan ee xal isticmaalaya isku-tallaabsiga
n-m-h1-logic-01.goal: Xal helaya isku-tallaabsiga shuruud lagu xidhay "iyo," hel oo saxo safka ugu horreeya ee qaldan, oo sharax sababta hadalka asalka ahi uusan u noqon been xataa haddii isku-tallaabsiga aan sax ahayn uu been yahay.
n-m-h1-logic-01.material: Kani waa xalka Minseo, kaas oo isticmaala isku-tallaabsiga si uu u go'aamiyo haddii hadalka "[Haddii x>0 iyo y>0, markaas xy>0]" uu run yahay ama been yahay, ee tirooyin dhab ah x, y. (xy waxay ka dhigan tahay x jibaar y.)
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.0: Raacitaanka xalka saf-saf si loo helo meesha ugu horreysa ee uu ka qaldamay
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.1: Tijaabinta shuruudda la beddelay adigoo isticmaalaya qiimayaal
n-m-h1-logic-01.thinking.2: Saxidda ilaa isku-soo-horjeedka sax ah iyo xukunka haddii hadalka asalka ahi run yahay ama been yahay
n-m-h1-logic-01.prereq.0: Isku-soo-horjeedka ~q→~p ee hadal p→q wuxuu leeyahay qiimo run/been isku mid ah asalka
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee xalka Minseo ee khaldamay.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi nidaamka sida saf kasta uga yimid safka isla markiiba ka horreeyay.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.hint.1: Dooro hal (x, y) oo p aan run ahayn, oo hubi haddii shuruudda ~p ee xalka lagu qoray ay ku jirto qiimahaas.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqoto p: x>0 iyo y>0, q: xy>0. Markaas hadalka la bixiyey waa p→q.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed isku-soo-horjeeduhu waa "Haddii xy≤0, markaas x≤0 iyo y≤0."
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.4: Haddii x=−1, y=2, markaas xy=−2≤0 laakiin y≤0 run ma aha, sidaas darteed isku-soo-horjeedkan waa been.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.line.5: Hadalka asalka ah iyo isku-soo-horjeedkiisu waxay leeyihiin qiimo run/been isku mid ah, sidaas darteed hadalka la bixiyey sidoo kale waa been.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s1.explain: Waa safka 3. Haddii p yahay "x>0 iyo y>0," markaas p oo aan run ahayn macnaheedu waa ma aha in labadaba ay togan yihiin, sidaas darteed waa "x≤0 ama y≤0." "x≤0 iyo y≤0" waa shuruud aad uga cidhiidhsan. Safka 4 wuxuu raacaa safka 3, xisaabta safka 5 na waa sax, laakiin gabagabada safka 6 waxay ka timaaddaa khaladka safka 3.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.prompt: Qor isku-soo-horjeedka sax ah, oo hal ama laba weedh ku qor haddii hadalka la bixiyey run yahay mise been yahay, sababta la socota.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir imisa ka mid ah labada shuruudood x>0, y>0 ayaa u baahan inay fashilmaan si p u noqoto been.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.hint.1: Beddel qiimayaal sida x=−1, y=2 isku-soo-horjeedkaaga la saxay, oo isku day dhowr lambar oo togan hadalka asalka ah.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Isku-soo-horjeedka sax ahi waa ..., sidaas darteed ...
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Marka aad qorayso isku-soo-horjeedka, ma hubisay adigoo isticmaalaya qiimayaal sababta "iyo" ugu beddelanayo "ama"?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday sababta hadalka asalku run u yahay adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqda ah in wax-isku-dhufashada tirooyin togan ay tahay togan?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma fahamtay sababta hadalka asalku been u ahayn inkasta oo isku-soo-horjeedka khaldan uu been yahay?
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.0: Isku-soo-horjeedka sax ahi waa "Haddii xy≤0, markaas x≤0 ama y≤0." Haddii x iyo y labaduba togan yihiin, wax-isku-dhufashadooduna sidoo kale waa togan, sidaas darteed hadalka asalku waa run.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.1: ~p waa x≤0 ama y≤0, sidaas darteed isku-soo-horjeeduhu waa: haddii xy≤0, markaas x≤0 ama y≤0. Wax-isku-dhufashada laba lambar oo togan waa togan, sidaas darteed hadalka la bixiyey waa run.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s2.model.2: ~p macnaheedu waa ugu yaraan mid ka mid ah x iyo y waa 0 ama ka yar, sidaas darteed isku-soo-horjeedka sax ahi waa "Haddii xy≤0, markaas x≤0 ama y≤0." Wax-isku-dhufashada laba lambar oo togan mar walba waa togan, sidaas darteed hadalka asalku waa run.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.prompt: Inkasta oo safka 5 muujiyey in isku-soo-horjeedka khaldan ee la qoray uu been yahay, gabagabada safka 6 waa khalad. Dooro sababta ugu habboon.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.0: Mar kale akhri labada hadal ee sifada "qiimo run/been isku mid ah leh" ay u dhexeyso.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qor hadalka Minseo iyo isku-soo-horjeedka sax ah dhinac dhinac oo barbar dhig haddii ay isla hadal yihiin.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.a: Hadalka Minseo ma aha isku-soo-horjeedka, sidaas darteed been ahaantiisa kuma gudbo hadalka asalka ah
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.b: Xitaa haddii isku-soo-horjeeduhu been yahay, hadalka asalku wuu run noqon karaa, sidaas darteed ma xukumi kartid run ama been adigoo isticmaalaya isku-soo-horjeedka
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad isku mid ka dhigtay isku-soo-horjeedka sax ah iyo hadalka si khaldan loo qoray. Isku-soo-horjeedka sax ahi mar walba wuxuu leeyahay qiimo run/been isku mid ah hadalka asalka.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.c: Hal tusaale lid ku ah ma muujin karo hadal kasta inuu been yahay, sidaas darteed caddaynta safka 5 waa daciif
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad hoos u dhigtay doorka tusaalaha lid ku ah. Hadalkan wuxuu been noqonayaa hal tusaale lid ku ah.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.o.d: Dib-u-rogga hadalka asalka ah sidoo kale waa in la hubiyo, sidaas darteed isku-soo-horjeedka oo keliya gabagabo ma bixin karo
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad ku qasatay dib-u-rogga iyo isku-soo-horjeedka. Qiimaha run/been ee hadalka asalka ah waxaa go'aamiya isku-soo-horjeedka oo keliya.
n-m-h1-logic-01.s.s3.explain: Isku-soo-horjeedka sax ah oo keliya ayaa leh qiimo run/been isku mid ah hadalka asalka. Hadalka Minseo ma aha isku-soo-horjeedka, sidaas darteed xitaa haddii been yahay, waxba kama sheego hadalka asalka. Isku-soo-horjeedka sax ahi mar walba wuxuu leeyahay qiimo run/been isku mid ah asalka, sidaas darteed waxaad xukumi kartaa adigoo isticmaalaya isku-soo-horjeedka (taasi waa sababta b u khaldan yahay), hal tusaale lid ku ahna wuu ku filan yahay in lagu muujiyo in hadal qaabka "dhammaan ..." been yahay (c). Dib-u-rogga wuxuu yeelan karaa qiimo run/been ka duwan asalka, sidaas darteed looma baahna in la hubiyo (d).

n-m-h1-logic-04.title: Samaynta Shuruud Lagama Maarmaan Ah Laakiin Aan Ku Filnayn
n-m-h1-logic-04.goal: Akhri "p waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah ee q" sida xiriir ku jirid oo u dhexeeya set-yada run-ka, oo dhis oo hubi shuruud lagama maarmaan ah laakiin aan ku filnayn.
n-m-h1-logic-04.material: Waxaa jira laba shuruudood oo ku saabsan lambar dhab ah x. q: −2≤x≤4. Iyo isku-dhufteyaal joogto ah a iyo b, p: a≤x≤b. Ha noqdaan set-yada run-ka ee labada shuruudood Q iyo P, siday u kala horreeyaan.
n-m-h1-logic-04.thinking.0: U beddelidda weedhda xiriir ku jirid oo set-yo ah
n-m-h1-logic-04.thinking.2: Helidda qiimayaal muujinaya inaanay ku filnayn
n-m-h1-logic-04.prereq.1: Macnaha shuruudaha lagama maarmaanka ah iyo kuwa ku filan
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xiriirka set-ka run-ka ee macno isku mid ah la leh "p waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah ee q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.0: Laga bilaabo weedhda, marka hore hel kee ayaa loo baahan yahay inuu run noqdo: "haddii q, markaas p" ama "haddii p, markaas q."
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.hint.1: Qaado curyaan set ka mid ah oo raac jihada ay tahay inuu ku jiro set-ka kale, ee P iyo Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad u akhrisay sida xiriirka halka "haddii p, markaas q" run yahay, taasi waa, halka p ay tahay shuruud ku filan.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad u akhrisay sida xiriir halka qiime midna uusan buuxin labada shuruudood. Shuruudda lagama maarmaanka ahi waa xiriir ku jirid.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad u akhrisay sida xiriir halka labada shuruudood ay isle'eg yihiin. Ahaanshaha lagama maarmaanka ma aha in labadu ay tahay inay siman yihiin.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s1.explain: "p waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah ee q" macnaheedu waa haddii q run yahay, markaas p waa inay run noqotaa, taasi waa, q⇒p. Curyaan kasta oo Q ahi wuxuu ku jiraa P, sidaas darteed Q⊂P. Haddii P⊂Q, markaas p waa shuruud ku filan ee q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.prompt: Gali saddex lammaane oo kala duwan oo tirooyin dhan a, b (−10≤a, b≤10) si p u noqoto shuruud lagama maarmaan ah laakiin aan ku filnayn ee q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sawir Q=[−2, 4] sida dhexe, oo go'aami sida P=[a, b] ay tahay inay daboosho Q.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kadib doorashada a iyo b, hel hal lambar dhab ah oo buuxiya p laakiin aan buuxin q, si aad u hubiso in mid runtii jiro.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan oo −10 ilaa 10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a iyo b waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo −10 ilaa 10.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c2: x kasta oo buuxiya q wuxuu sidoo kale buuxiyaa p (shuruud lagama maarmaan ah).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Qaar x ah oo buuxiya q ma buuxiyaan p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Waxaa jira x buuxiya p laakiin aan buuxin q (sidaas darteed ma aha shuruud ku filan).
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.fail.c3: p iyo q waa isla shuruud, sidaas darteed p sidoo kale waa shuruud ku filan.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.explain: P=[a, b] waa inay ka kooban tahay Q=[−2, 4] iyadoo aan le'eg ahayn. Tusaale ahaan, ee (−5, 6), P=[−5, 6], x=5 na wuxuu buuxiyaa p laakiin aan buuxin q. Ee (−2, 4), P=Q, sidaas darteed p waa shuruud lagama maarmaan ah oo ku filan labadaba.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Dooro mid ka mid ah lammaanayaasha (a, b) oo qor ① hal qiime oo x ah oo buuxiya p laakiin aan buuxin q, iyo ② sababta x kasta oo buuxiya q uu sidoo kale buuxiyo p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Marka hore qor dhexda [a, b] adigoo isticmaalaya qiimayaasha a iyo b ee adiga kuu gaar ah.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Dooro hal lambar oo ku jira dhexdaas laakiin aan ku jirin [−2, 4].
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in x aad doortay runtii ku jiro [a, b] laakiin aan ku jirin [−2, 4]?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday ② adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqda ah in labada dhammaad ee Q, −2 iyo 4, ay ku jiraan P gudaheeda?
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Marka (a, b)=(−5, 6), x=5 wuxuu buuxiyaa p sababtoo ah −5≤x≤6, laakiin wuu ka weyn yahay 4, sidaas darteed ma buuxiyo q. x kasta oo leh −2≤x≤4 wuxuu u dhexeeyaa −5 iyo 6, sidaas darteed wuxuu sidoo kale buuxiyaa p.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.1: Haddii aan qaado (−3, 4), markaas x=−3 wuxuu buuxiyaa p laakiin aan buuxin q. Baaxadda q, [−2, 4], gebi ahaanba waxay ku jirtaa [−3, 4], sidaas darteed mar kasta oo q run tahay, p mar walba waa run.
n-m-h1-logic-04.s.s2.because.model.2: Haddii a=-3 iyo b=5, markaas 5 wuxuu buuxiyaa p laakiin aan buuxin q. Lambar kasta oo buuxiya q wuxuu u dhexeeyaa -3 iyo 5, sidaas darteed wuxuu sidoo kale buuxiyaa p.

n-m-h1-comb-01.title: Hubinta xal tirinaya siyaabaha xarfaha loogu dhigi karo sanduuqyada boostada
n-m-h1-comb-01.topic: Tirinta: maxay tahay inay tallaabooyinka xeerka wax-isku-dhufashada ku salaysan yihiin?
n-m-h1-comb-01.goal: Xal isticmaalay xeerka wax-isku-dhufashada, hubi haddii "waxa tallaabo tallaabo la go'aamiyey" ay la jaanqaadayso shuruudaha dhibaatada, hel safka khaldan, oo ku xaqiiji adigoo si toos ah u taxaya xaalad yar.
n-m-h1-comb-01.material: Waxaan rabnaa inaan geliyo 4 xaraf oo kala duwan 3 sanduuq boostada, dhammaantood. Sanduuq boostada wuxuu heli karaa xaraf dhowr ah, sanduuq kasta na laga yaabaa inuusan helin xaraf gabi ahaanba. Sujin ayaa ugu xalliyey xeerka wax-isku-dhufashada sida hoos ku qoran. (4³ waa lambarka aad hesho marka aad ku dhufato 4 saddex jeer.)
n-m-h1-comb-01.thinking.0: Ha beddelin waxa la tirinayo (mawduuca) iyo doorashooyinka
n-m-h1-comb-01.thinking.1: Hubi odhaahda adigoo taxaya xaalad yar
n-m-h1-comb-01.thinking.2: Ku dhis shuruudaha dhibaatada (dhammaan xarfaha waa la geliyey, xaraf dhowr ah ayaa la oggol yahay) odhaahda gudaheeda
n-m-h1-comb-01.prereq.1: Khibrad tirinta siyaabaha lagu dhigi karo shayada kala duwan goobo dhowr ah adigoo isticmaalaya jaantus geed ama liis
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka koowaad ee khaldan ee xalka Sujin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hoosta ka xarriiq shuruudaha "dhammaantood waa la geliyey" iyo "xaraf dhowr ah ayaa la geli karaa" dhibaatada.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.1: Saf kasta, si kooban u qor waxa Sujin tallaabo tallaabo go'aamiso iyo waxa ay ka dooratay.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.hint.2: Hubi haddii, iyadoo la adeegsanayo doorashooyinkaas, dhammaan 4-ta xaraf ay gelaan sanduuqyada boostada adigoon midna ka tagin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.0: Si loo tiriyo siyaabaha adigoo isticmaalaya xeerka wax-isku-dhufashada, waxaan hawsha u kala qaybinnaa tallaabooyin.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.1: Marka hore waxaan si isku xigta u eegnaa 3-da sanduuq boostada, sanduuq kasta na waxaan ka dooranaa hal xaraf oo la geliyo 4-ta xaraf ka mid ah.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.2: Sanduuq kasta waxaa jira 4 hab oo la doorto.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.line.3: Maadaama ay jiraan 3 sanduuq boostada, tirada waa 4×4×4=4³=64 hab.
n-m-h1-comb-01.s.s1.explain: Waa safka 2. Dhibaatadan waxay ku saabsan tahay dhigidda "dhammaan 4-ta xaraf" sanduuqyada boostada. Haddii aad ka dooratid hal xaraf oo keliya sanduuq kasta, waxaad ku qasaysaa xaaladaha halka hal sanduuq uu helo laba xaraf ama xaraf qaar aan la gelin, sidaas darteed ma tirinayso xaaladda dhibaatada. n-m-h1-eq-01.title: Qiimaha √(−2)·√(−3): kee ka mid ah labada xal ayaa sax ah?
n-m-h1-eq-01.topic: Lambarrada isku dhafan: ku dhufashada xididada laba-jibbaarka ee lambarrada taban iyo baaxadda xeerka xididdadu run ka yahay
n-m-h1-eq-01.goal: Hubi adigoo si toos ah u xisaabinaya qiyamka haddii xeerka ku dhufashada ee labada xidid loo isticmaali karo sida uu yahay marka lambarrada xididka hoostiisa ku jira ay yihiin kuwo taban, oo ku soo koob hal jumlad baaxadda xeerku run ka yahay.
n-m-h1-eq-01.material:
Seonu iyo Haeun mid walba wuxuu helay qiimaha √(−2)·√(−3).
Seonu: √(−2)·√(−3)=√((−2)×(−3))=√6
Haeun: √(−2)=√2·i, √(−3)=√3·i, sidaas darteed √(−2)·√(−3)=√2·i·√3·i=√6·i²=−√6
(Halkan √ waxay la macno tahay xididka laba-jibbaarka, waxaana ku heshiinay in xididka laba-jibbaarka ee lambar taban −k uu yahay √(−k)=√k·i.)

n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.1: Tijaabi haddii xeerku run yahay adigoo beddelaya lambarrada
n-m-h1-eq-01.thinking.2: Ku soo koob erayo baaxadda xeerku run ka yahay
n-m-h1-eq-01.prereq.1: Ku dhufashada iyadoo la adeegsanayo i²=−1
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.prompt: Eeg labada xal oo dooro xukunka ugu habboon.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.0: Hel halka lambarka xididka hoostiisa ku jira uu yahay taban labada xal, oo barbar dhig sida xal kasta u maareeyay lambarkaas taban.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.hint.1: Adigoo raacaya heshiiska u beddela √(−2) √2·i, si toos ah u xisaabi bilowga ilaa dhammaadka oo go'aami qiimaha xalka kee ayuu la mid yahay.

n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.a: Wuxuu u malaystay in √a·√b=√(ab) uu run yahay xitaa marka lambarro taban ay ku lug leeyihiin. Dib u eeg noocee lambarro a iyo b ayaa xeerkan loo sameeyay.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.b: Lama go'aamin karo: xididka laba-jibbaarka ee lambar taban ma laha hal qiime

n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.o.c: Haeun: marka hore wuxuu u beddelaa cutubka ka-qaabeedka ka dibna wuu ku dhufto, sidaas darteed qiimuhu waa −√6

n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.r.d: √6 iyo −√6 waa lambarro kala duwan. Ka fikir waxa loo baahan lahaa si ay siman u noqdaan.
n-m-h1-eq-01.s.s1.explain: Iyadoo la raacayo heshiiska √(−k)=√k·i, √(−2)·√(−3)=√2 i·√3 i=√6·i²=−√6. Xalka Seonu wuxuu u isticmaalay √a·√b=√(ab) sida uu yahay xitaa marka a iyo b labaduba ay yihiin taban, sidaas darteed wuxuu u soo baxay √6.

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.prompt: Qor qiimaha saxda ah ee ω^2026, oo muuji in hab kale (tusaale ahaan, isticmaalka qiimaha ω⁶ iyo hadhaaga marka loo qaybiyo 6) uu siinayo isla qiime.

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.hint.1: Haddii ω³=−1, hel qiimaha ω⁶, kadibna mar kale xisaabi adigoo isticmaalaya hadhaaga marka 2026 loo qaybiyo tibaaxdaas.

n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.0: ω^2026=−ω. Maadaama ω³=−1, (ω³)^675=(−1)^675=−1. Hab kale, ω⁶=1 iyo 2026=6×337+4, sidaa darteed ω^2026=ω⁴=ω³·ω=−ω, taasoo isku mid ah.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s2.model.1: (ω³)^675=(−1)^675 waa −1 sababtoo ah tibaaxdu waa kali. Sidaa darteed ω^2026 waa −ω. Tanina waxay la jaan qaadaysaa xaqiiqda ah in hadhaaga 4 marka loo qaybiyo 6 uu siinayo ω⁴=−ω.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.prompt: Ee xidid khayaali ah ω ee x²−x+1=0, hel oo geli saddex tiro dabiici ah oo kala duwan k (1≤k≤60) oo ω^k=1.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kordhi tibaaxda sida ω³, ω⁶, ω⁹ oo qor qiimayaasha si kala horreyn ah.
n-m-h1-eq-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hel tibaaxda ugu horreysa ee qiimuhu noqdo 1, kadibna tijaabi haddii ay isku mid tahay jibaarrada tibaaxdaas.

n-m-h1-eq-03.title: Haddii hal xidid uu yahay 1+i, ma xididka kale waa 1−i?
n-m-h1-eq-03.topic: Xididada khayaaliga ah ee isla'egyada laba-darajada ah: shuruudda dammaanad qaadaysa xidid isku-xidhan
n-m-h1-eq-03.goal: Aqoonso macluumaadka loo baahan yahay si loo go'aamiyo xididka kale marka hal xidid uu khayaali yahay, oo samee tusaale halkaas oo gabagabadu is beddesho marka macluumaadkaas maqan yahay.
n-m-h1-eq-03.material: Ka soo qaad hal xidid ee x²+px+q=0 inuu yahay 1+i. Soyeon wuxuu sheegay, "Xididka kale waa inuu noqdaa 1−i," Jeonghun na wuxuu yiri, "Ma hubin kartid taas." (Weli lama oga tirooyinka p iyo q waa maxay.)
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.0: Hel shuruudda qarsoon ee loo baahan yahay si gabagabadu run u noqoto
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.1: Naftaada samee tusaale lid ku ah oo hubi
n-m-h1-eq-03.thinking.2: Sharax sababta tusaale lid ku ahi u muujiyo in shuruud lagama maarmaan tahay
n-m-h1-eq-03.prereq.0: Xiriirka u dhexeeya labada xidid iyo isu-dheelitirrada isla'eg laba-darajo ah
n-m-h1-eq-03.prereq.1: Isku darka iyo ku dhufashada tirooyinka isku-dhafan

n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.0: Ha ahaato xididka kale a+bi oo si toos ah u qor isugeynta iyo wax-ku-dhaca labada xidid iyadoo la adeegsanayo a iyo b.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.hint.1: Qor tibaaxda ay shuruudda doorasho kasta siinayso a iyo b, oo raadi xaalad buuxisa taas iyadoo a+bi aysan ahayn 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.a: Haddii aadan aqoon haddii p iyo q yihiin kuwo dhab ah, p²−4q wuxuu noqon karaa tiro isku-dhafan, sidaa darteed erayga "taban" laftigiisu ma lahaan karo qeexid.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.b: Xataa haddii isugeyntu tahay mid dhab ah, xididka kale laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn 1−i. Ha ahaato xididka kale a+bi oo baar qaybta khayaaliga ah ee isugeynta.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.o.c: Wax-ku-dhaca labada xidid, q, waa dhab
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.r.c: Xataa haddii wax-ku-dhacu yahay mid dhab ah, xididka kale laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn 1−i. Ha ahaato xididka kale a+bi oo baar qaybta khayaaliga ah ee wax-ku-dhaca.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.o.d: Isu-dheelitirrada p iyo q labaduba waa dhab
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s1.explain: Kaliya marka p iyo q labaduba ay dhab yihiin ayaa tiro isku-dhafan oo isku-xidhan ay tahay xidid. Isugeynta oo keliya ama wax-ku-dhaca oo keliya oo dhab ah kuma filna. Haddii labaduba dhab yihiin, waa xaaladda p iyo q ay dhab yihiin, gabagabaduna waa go'an tahay.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.prompt: Ha ahaato xididka kale a+bi (a, b waa tirooyin dhan laga bilaabo −9 ilaa 9). Geli saddex lammaane (a, b) oo kala duwan oo isugeynta labada xidid ay dhab tahay xididka kalena aanu ahayn 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qor qaybta dhabta ah iyo qaybta khayaaliga ah ee isugeynta (1+i)+(a+bi) adigoo isticmaalaya a iyo b.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.hint.1: Go'aamin qaybta kee ayaa waa inay noqotaa 0 si isugeyntu u noqoto mid dhab ah, oo tijaabi adigoo beddelaya qiimaha a shuruuddaas hoosteeda.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.var.a: Qaybta dhabta ah a ee xididka kale
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.var.b: Qaybta khayaaliga ah b ee xididka kale
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa tirooyin dhan xadka dhexdiisa.

n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Xididka kale wuxuu soo baxaa inuu yahay 1−i. Waa inaad hesho xaalad ka duwan sheegashada Soyeon.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s2.explain: Si isugeyntu u noqoto mid dhab ah, qaybta khayaaliga ah 1+b waa inay noqotaa 0, sidaa darteed b=−1, haddii a aysan ahayn 1, xididka kale maaha 1−i. Tusaale ahaan, haddii xididdadu yihiin 1+i iyo 3−i, isugeyntu waa 4, taasoo dhab ah, laakiin xididka kale maaha 1−i.
n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.prompt: Eeg isla'egta leh xididada 1+i iyo 3−i: isugeyntu waa dhab, laakiin sheegashada Soyeon ma run aha. Sidoo kale xisaabi wax-ku-dhaca labada xidid, oo qor sababta isla'egtani u tahay tusaale lid ku ah sheegashada Soyeon.

n-m-h1-eq-03.s.s3.model.1: Isugeyntu waa 4, taasoo dhab ah, laakiin wax-ku-dhacu waa 4+2i, kaas oo leh qayb khayaali ah oo aan dhab ahayn. Isu-dheelitirrada isla'egtan dhammaantood dhab ma aha, sidaa darteed shuruudda ah in isu-dheelitirradu yihiin dhab la'aanteed, ma odhan karno xididka kale waa 1−i.

n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir xadka qiimayaasha aad had iyo jeer hesho marka aad labajibbaarto tiro dhab ah x.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.a: Waa ku filan yahay in t uu yahay tiro dhan
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.a: Marka x=√t, xataa haddii t uu yahay tiro dhan, x maaha dhab marka t uu yahay taban. Waxa muhiimka ah waa calaamadda, ma aha haddii ay tahay tiro dhan.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.b: Waa ku filan yahay in t uu yahay tiro dhab ah
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.b: Xataa haddii t uu dhab yahay, marka uu taban yahay x dhab ah oo x²=t ma jiro. Isku day inaad xallisid x²=−4 ee t=−4.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.c: t waa tiro dhab ah oo ugu yaraan 0 ah
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.o.d: t waa tiro dhan oo ka weyn 0
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.r.d: Xataa marka t uu yahay 0, x=0 waa xidid dhab ah, xataa marka t aysan ahayn tiro dhan, xididada dhabta ah ayaa soo baxa. Shuruuddu aad bay u cidhiidhsan tahay.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s1.explain: Haddii x uu dhab yahay, x²=t waa ugu yaraan 0. Rogista, haddii t uu yahay tiro dhab ah oo ugu yaraan 0, markaas x=±√t waa xididada dhabta ah. Haddii t uu yahay taban, x wuxuu noqdaa lammaane khayaali ah oo isku-xidhan midba midka kale.

n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mid ka mid ah labada xidid ee t waa 4. Eeg waxa xididada isla'egta asalka ah noqdaan marka xididka kale uu togan yahay, 0, ama taban.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a iyo b waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo −20≤a≤20.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Gelinta x=2 ma siiso 0. Hubi qiimaha 16+4a+b.

n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.explain: Haddii x=2, markaas t=4 waa xidid ee t²+at+b=0, sidaa darteed 16+4a+b=0. t kale waa −a−4, qiimahaasna waa inuu noqdaa taban, sidaa darteed b=4(−a−4)<0. Tusaale ahaan, (a, b)=(−3, −4) wuxuu siinayaa (t−4)(t+1)=0, sidaa darteed x=±2, ±i.
n-m-h1-eq-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqada ah in wax-ku-dhaca labada xidid ee isla'egta laba-darajada ee t uu yahay b, sharax sababta, marka b<0, isla'egta asalka ahi u leedahay saxda laba xidid oo dhab ah.
