n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii calaamadda tirmada joogtada ah ay la mid tahay ama ka soo horjeedo wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.0: Ha noqdaan saddexda xidid ee x³−2x²−5x+k=0 α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.1: Xiriirka xididdada iyo isku-dhufteyaasha, wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid waa tirmada joogtada ah k loo qaybiyo isku-dhufteyaasha hogaaminaya 1, sidaas darteed αβγ=k.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.line.3: Sidaas darteed qiimaha k ee aan rabno waa −6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s1.explain: Safka 2 waa khalad. Isla'eg saddex-jibbaaran, wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid waa −(tirmada joogtada ah)÷(isku-dhufteyaasha hogaaminaya), sidaas darteed αβγ=−k. Markaas −k=−6 waxay siinaysaa k=6. Safafka 3 iyo 4 waa xisaabo raacaya safka 2.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.prompt: Qor qiimaha la saxay ee k, oo qor habka lagu hubinayo in wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid runtii yahay −6 k kaas ah, adigoo u qaybinaya isla'egta ama beddelaya xidid.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.0: Saxo safka khaldan oo mar kale hel k, ka dibna qor isla'egta k-gaas leh oo hel hal lambar dhan oo xidid ah.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.hint.1: Marka aad hesho hal xidid, u qaybi si aad u hesho xididdada kale oo ku dhufo saddexda xidid.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Marka k=6, ma u qaybisay x³−2x²−5x+6 oo ma heshay saddexda xidid?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma si toos ah u dhufatay saddexda xidid oo ma hubisay inaad hesho −6?
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.0: αβγ=−k, sidaas darteed −k=−6 waxay siinaysaa k=6. Hubin: x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), sidaas darteed saddexda xidid waa 1, 3, −2 wax-isku-dhufashaduna waa 1×3×(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.1: Calaamadda tirmada joogtada ah way ka soo horjeedaa, sidaas darteed wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid waa −k. Sidaas darteed k=6, beddelka x=1 na wuxuu siinayaa 1−2−5+6=0, sidaas darteed waa xidid. Qorista sida (x−1)(x−3)(x+2), wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid waa 1·3·(−2)=−6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s2.model.2: k=6. x³−2x²−5x+6=(x−1)(x−3)(x+2), sidaas darteed xididdadu waa 1, 3, −2 wax-isku-dhufashaduna waa −6.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.prompt: Dooro xiriirada sax ah marka saddexda xidid ee x³+ax²+bx+c=0 ay yihiin α, β, γ.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.0: Qor isla'egta saddex-jibbaaran ee leh xididdo 1, 2, 3 sida (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=0, ballaadhi, oo hel a, b, c.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.hint.1: Beddel a, b, c aad heshay odhaahda doorasho kasta oo hel tan la jaanqaadaysa wadarta iyo wax-isku-dhufashada saddexda xidid.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.b: Waxaad u akhrisay isku-dhufteyaasha sida ay yihiin. Barbar dhig wadarta 6 iyo qiimaha a marka saddexda xidid ay yihiin 1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.c: Waxaad ku qasatay calaamadaha labaad iyo saddexaad iyo calaamadaha laba-jibbaaran. Xisaabi qiimayaasha b iyo c marka xididdadu yihiin 1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.r.d: Ma beddelin calaamadda wadarta. Hel qiimaha a marka xididdadu yihiin 1, 2, 3.
n-m-h1-eq-08.s.s3.explain: (x−1)(x−2)(x−3)=x³−6x²+11x−6, sidaas darteed a=−6, b=11, c=−6. Wadarta 6=−a, wadarta wax-isku-dhufashooyinka laba xidid 11=b, iyo wax-isku-dhufashada 6=−c.

n-m-h1-eq-06.title: Dib u qorista "xidid ma leh haddii D<0" si ay ugu habboonaato dhagaystayaasha
n-m-h1-eq-06.topic: Kala-saaraha isla'egta laba-jibbaaran: kala saarista "xidid dhab ah ma leh" iyo "xidid ma leh"
n-m-h1-eq-06.goal: Dib u qor hadalka ku saabsan kala-saaraha si sax ah u habboon dhagaystayaasha (walaal yar oo fasalka 9aad ah, ardayga fasalkaaga), oo hel qodobka halka erayada aan sheegin nidaamka lambarrada ay abuurto fahan khaldan.
n-m-h1-eq-06.material: Gyumin wuxuu qoray qodobbada ugu muhiimsan ee kala-saaraha buug-qoraal si uu ugu sharaxo xididdada isla'egaha laba-jibbaaran walaalkiis yar, kaas oo fasalka 9aad ku jira. (a, b, c waa tirooyin dhab ah a≠0 na.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.1: Qor isla nuxurka erayo kala duwan si ay ugu habboonaato dhagaystayaasha
n-m-h1-eq-06.thinking.2: Sheeg nidaamka lambarrada si aad si sax ah u qorto
n-m-h1-eq-06.prereq.1: Macnaha xididdada khayaaliga ah iyo tirooyinka isku-dhafan
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.prompt: Dooro safka buug-qoraalka Gyumin ee aan sax ahayn.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.0: Hubi nidaamka lambarrada saf kasta u qaadanayo.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qaado isla'eg leh D taban, sida x²+1=0, oo ka fikir haddii runtii aysan lahayn xal gabi ahaanba.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.0: Isla'eg laba-jibbaaran ax²+bx+c=0, waxaan u yeernaa D=b²−4ac.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.1: Haddii D>0, wuxuu leeyahay laba xidid oo dhab ah oo kala duwan.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.line.3: Haddii D=0, wuxuu leeyahay xidid dhab ah oo labajeer ah.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s1.explain: Safka 3 ma aha mid sax ah. Haddii D<0 xidid dhab ah ma jiro, laakiin dugsiga sare tirooyinka waxaa loo ballaadhiyaa tirooyin isku-dhafan, isla'egtuna waxay leedahay laba xidid oo khayaali ah oo isku-guuraya midba midka kale. Safafka 1, 2, iyo 4 waa sax.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor safka 3 hal ama laba weedh si uu walaalkaaga yar ee fasalka 9aad u fahmo. (Wali ma barin tirooyin khayaali ah, laakiin wuxuu yaqaan garaafyada.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor nidaamkee lambarrada "xidid ma leh" lagu yiri, kadibna baaxaddaas gali weedhda.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.hint.1: Xusuuso halka xididdada isla'egtu ku muuqdaan garaafka oo ku xidh weedhda.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Halkii aad "xidid ma leh" sida uu yahay u qori lahayd, ma sheegtay nidaamkee lambarrada aad ula jeeddo?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday adigoo isticmaalaya fikradda garaafyada ee walaalkaaga yaqaan?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.0: Haddii D<0, tirooyinka dhabta ah dhexdooda xidid ma jiro. Garaafka (parabola) ma kulmo ulaha x. Haddii aan ballaadhino tirooyin la yiraahdo tirooyin khayaali ah, xididdo ayaa soo muuqda, laakiin taas waad baran doontaa mar dambe.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s2.model.1: Haddii D<0, xidid dhab ah ma jiro. Tani waxay la micno tahay garaafka y=ax²+bx+c ma kulmo ulaha x. Dugsiga sare, marka tirooyinka la ballaadhiyo, nooc kale oo xidid ah ayaa soo muuqda.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.prompt: Markan, dib u qor isla safka 3 erayo sax ah oo qoraal uu akhriyo saaxiib fasalka 10aad ah. (Qor labadaba tirada iyo nooca xididdada.)
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.0: Jumladda walaalkaaga fasalka 9aad, "waxa aad baran doonto xiga" waa laga tagay. Markan, si toos ah u qor.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi imisa xidid oo khayaali ah ayaa jira iyo sida labada xidid ee khayaaliga ahi isu xiriiraan, adigoo u isticmaalaya xalalka x²+1=0 tixraac.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay imisa xidid oo khayaali ah ayaa jira iyo sida ay isu xiriiraan?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Si ka duwan sharaxaadda fasalka 9aad, ma ballaadhisay nidaamka lambarrada ilaa tirooyin isku-dhafan?
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.0: Haddii D<0, xidid dhab ah ma jiro, waxaana jira laba xidid oo khayaali ah oo kala duwan oo isku-guuraya midba midka kale.
n-m-h1-eq-06.s.s3.model.1: Haddii D<0, xidid dhab ah ma jiro, laakiin tirooyinka isku-dhafan dhexdooda waxaa jira 2 xidid oo khayaali ah. Labada xidid waa isku-guuraha isku-dhafan midba midka kale.

n-m-h1-eq-07.title: Samaynta lammaanayaasha taabbagalka i^p+i^q=0
n-m-h1-eq-07.topic: Tirooyinka isku-dhafan: taabbagalada cutubka khayaaliga ah i iyo shuruudda wadartu tahay 0
n-m-h1-eq-07.goal: Isticmaal qaabka soo noqnoqda ee taabbagalada i si aad adigu u samayso lammaanayaal taabbagal ah oo wadartoodu tahay 0, oo soo koob erayo waxa lammaanayaashaasi wadaagaan.
n-m-h1-eq-07.material: Cutubka khayaaliga ah i wuxuu buuxiyaa i²=−1. Qaadashada taabbagalada i waxay siinaysaa i, i²=−1, i³, i⁴, …, haddii aad qiimayaasha u qorto nidaamka, isla qiimayaasha ayaa soo noqnoqda. Tixgeli i^p+i^q ee tirooyin dabiici ah p, q. (i^p macnaheedu waa i taabbagalka p.)
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.0: Hel qaabka taabbagaladu ku soo noqnoqdaan
n-m-h1-eq-07.thinking.2: Guud ka dhig oo sharax waxa tusaalayaashaad samaysay wadaagaan
n-m-h1-eq-07.prereq.0: Cutubka khayaaliga ah i iyo i²=−1
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.0: Xisaabi i¹, i², i³, i⁴, i⁵, i⁶ nidaamka oo qor sida qiimayaashu u sii socdaan.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hel taabbagalka halka qiimayaashu marka hore soo noqnoqdaan, oo hel hadhaaga marka 2025 loo qaybiyo lambarkaas.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.b: i²=−1 waa qiimaha marka taabbagalku yahay 2. Eeg waxa hadhaagu yahay marka 2025 loo qaybiyo 4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.c: i³=−i waa marka hadhaaga taabbagalka loo qaybiyo 4 uu yahay 3. Hel hadhaaga marka 2025 loo qaybiyo 4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.r.d: i⁴=1 waa marka taabbagalku yahay jajab-laab 4. Hubi hadhaaga marka 2025 loo qaybiyo 4.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s1.explain: i, −1, −i, 1 waxay ku soo noqnoqdaan kooxo afar ah. Hadhaaga marka 2025 loo qaybiyo 4 waa 1, sidaas darteed i²⁰²⁵=i¹=i.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.prompt: Samee saddex lammaane oo kala duwan (p, q) oo tirooyin dabiici ah ah (1≤p, q≤40) oo i^p+i^q=0, oo gali.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.0: Qor qiimayaasha i¹ ilaa i⁸ oo hel lammaanayaasha laba qiime oo wadartoodu tahay 0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.hint.1: Marka aad hesho lammaane, tijaabi haddii kordhinta taabbagalada 4 ay siinayso isla qiimayaal, oo beddel taabbagalada si aad u samayso lammaanayaal cusub.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Waa tirooyin dabiici ah baaxadda dhexdeeda.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c1: p iyo q waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dabiici ah oo 1 ilaa 40.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.ok.c2: i^p iyo i^q waa ka soo horjeedaan, sidaas darteed wadartu waa 0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.fail.c2: i^p+i^q ma aha 0. Qor labada qiime si toos ah.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s2.explain: i¹+i³=i+(−i)=0, i²+i⁸=−1+1=0, i¹⁰+i⁴=−1+1=0. Marka hadhaaga p−q loo qaybiyo 4 uu yahay 2, labada qiime waa ka soo horjeedaan.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.prompt: Sheeg hadhaaga marka p−q loo qaybiyo 4 ee lammaanayaasha aad samaysay, oo sharax sababta i^p+i^q ay u tahay 0 markaas, adigoo ka saaraya i^q.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.0: Saddexda lammaane ee aad samaysay, hel p−q, qor hadhaag kasta marka loo qaybiyo 4, oo hel waxa wadaagaan.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.hint.1: Qor i^p sida wax-isku-dhufashada i^q iyo i^(p−q), oo shaqee qiimaha i^(p−q) leeyahay.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.placeholder: Tusaale: Maadaama hadhaaga p−q loo qaybiyo 4 uu yahay ..., ...
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma xisaabisay p−q si toos ah saddexda lammaane ee aad samaysay?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma isticmaashay xaqiiqda ah in i^p loo qori karo qaabka i^q·i^(p−q)?
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.0: Hadhaaga p−q loo qaybiyo 4 waa 2. Gudaha i^p+i^q=i^q(i^(p−q)+1), i^(p−q) wuxuu le'eg yahay i²=−1, sidaas darteed gudaha qaansooyinka waa −1+1=0 wadartuna waa 0.
n-m-h1-eq-07.s.s3.model.1: Farqiga p iyo q wuxuu ka tagaa hadhaag 2 marka loo qaybiyo 4. Markaas i^p waa i^q jeer i²=−1, sidaas darteed wuxuu leeyahay calaamad ka soo horjeeda i^q, isku darka labadana wuxuu siinayaa 0.

n-m-h1-eq-09.title: Haddii midkoodna musharaxiinta xididka dhan aanu ahayn xidid, ma xidid dhab ahi sidoo kale ma jiro?
n-m-h1-eq-09.topic: Isla'egaha heerka sare: hubinta musharaxiinta xididka dhan iyo jiritaanka xididdada dhabta ah
n-m-h1-eq-09.goal: Kala sooc waxa natiijada hubinta dhammaan musharaxiinta xididka dhan noo sheegto iyo waxa aysan noo sheegin, oo muuji in xidid dhab ah uu jiro adigoo isticmaalaya isbeddelka calaamadda ee qiimayaasha shaqada.
n-m-h1-eq-09.material: Jiwon wuxuu isku dayay inuu xalliyo isla'egta f(x)=0 ee f(x)=x³−3x−1. Xidid dhan oo isla'eg isku-dhufteyaal dhan leh oo isku-dhufteyaasha hogaaminaya yahay 1 waa mid ka mid ah qaybiyayaasha tirmada joogtada ah −1. Jiwon wuxuu beddelay musharaxiinta 1, −1 oo hubiyey in f(1)=−3 iyo f(−1)=1 labaduba aanay ahayn 0, wuxuuna gabagabeeyey "isla'egtan xidid dhab ah ma laha." Daeun wuxuu yiri, "Haddii aad ka fikirto garaafka isla'eg saddex-jibbaaran, gabagabada Jiwon waa yaab."
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.0: Aqoonso baaxadda ay natiijooyinka hubintu taageeraan
n-m-h1-eq-09.thinking.2: Sharax sababta xidid dhab ah u jiro inkasta oo xidid dhan aanu jirin
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.0: Aragtida qodobka iyo musharaxiinta xididka dhan (qaybiyayaasha tirmada joogtada ah)
n-m-h1-eq-09.prereq.1: Xisaabinta qiimayaasha shaqada iyo qaabka joogtada ah ee garaaf
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.prompt: Dooro xukunka ugu habboon ee ku saabsan hubinta iyo gabagabada Jiwon.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.0: Qor nooca lambarrada ay natiijada hubinta musharaxiinta xididka dhan ka hadlayso.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi haddii hubintu ay ku jirto aasaas lagu saaro suurtagalnimada in lambar aan dhan ahayn uu buuxiyo f(x)=0.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.a: Sax: haddii midkoodna musharaxiintu aanu ahayn xidid, xidid dhab ah sidoo kale ma jiro
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad ula dhaqantay xididdada dhan iyo xididdada dhabta ah sida isku mid. Ka fikir haddii tirooyin dhab ah oo aan dhan ahayn ay noqon karaan xididdada isla'egta.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.b: Khalad: haddii musharaxiinta ±1 aanay ahayn xididdo, macnaheedu waa xidid dhan ma jiro
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.c: Khalad: xisaabaha f(1) iyo f(−1) waa khalad
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.c: f(1)=1−3−1=−3 iyo f(−1)=−1+3−1=1, sidaas darteed xisaabuhu waa sax. Eeg haddii dhibaatadu tahay gabagabada, ma aha xisaabta.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.o.d: Lama ogaan karo: aragtida qodobka looma isticmaali karo isla'eg saddex-jibbaaran
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.r.d: Aragtida qodobka waxaa loo isticmaali karaa odhaahyada saddex-jibbaaran sidoo kale. Arrintu waa waxa ay noo sheegto marka musharax uusan ahayn xidid.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s1.explain: Marka dhammaan musharaxiinta la hubiyo, waxaan odhan karnaa "xidid dhan ma jiro" oo keliya. Waxaa jiri kara xidid dhab ah oo aan dhan ahayn, sidaas darteed gabagabada "xidid dhab ah ma jiro" hubintu ma taageerto.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.prompt: Ee f(x)=x³−3x−1, hel oo gali saddex lammaane oo kala duwan (m, n) oo f(m)<0, f(n)>0, m iyo n na ay yihiin tirooyin dhan oo ku kala duwan 1 (−5≤m, n≤5).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.0: Xisaabi f(m) nidaamka m ee −5 ilaa 5, ku qor jadwal, oo calaamadee calaamadaha oo keliya.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.hint.1: Jadwalka, hel meel kasta oo unug togan uu ag yaal unug taban.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.var.m: Lambar dhan m oo leh f(m)<0
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.var.n: Lambar dhan n oo leh f(n)>0
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.ok.c1: m iyo n waa tirooyin dhan oo deris ah baaxadda dhexdeeda.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c1: m iyo n waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo −5 ilaa 5 ah oo ku kala duwan 1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c2: f(m) ma aha taban. Xisaabi f(m) si toos ah.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.fail.c3: f(n) ma aha mid togan. Si toos ah u xisaabi f(n).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s2.explain: f(−2)=−3, f(−1)=1, f(0)=−1, f(1)=−3, f(2)=1. Lammaanayaasha is-xiga ee calaamaddu isbeddesho waa (−2, −1), (0, −1), (1, 2).
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.prompt: Qor sababta, (m, n) oo f(m) iyo f(n) ay leeyihiin calaamado ka soo horjeeda, xidid run ah oo f(x)=0 uu u dhexeeyo, iyo sababta xididkaas run ahi uga duwan yahay musharraxiinta Jiwon hubisay.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.0: Sawir garaafka oo ka fikir haddii, marka uu ka tago dhinaca taban uu aado dhinaca togan isagoo aan jabin, uu ku qasban yahay inuu jaro dhidibka x.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.hint.1: Qor labada tiro ee dhan ee dhexdooda xididka aad heshay yaallo, oo barbar dhig haddii qiimahaasi la mid noqon karo ±1.
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma qortay labadaba in calaamadda qiimaha shaqadu is beddesho iyo in garaafku isku xiran yahay?
n-m-h1-eq-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay in xididka run ah ee aad heshay uu u dhexeeyo tirooyin dhan oo sidaas darteed aanu ahayn musharraxiinta ±1?

n-m-h1-logic-07.title: Helista laba lambar oo urur-jibbaarradoodu leeyihiin ururin leh 12 xubnood
n-m-h1-logic-07.goal: Tiri xubnaha ururinta urur-jibbaarrada labada lambar adigoo isticmaalaya ku darid-ka-reebid, oo isticmaal xaqiiqda ah in xubnaha guud ay yihiin jibbaarrada jibbaarka guud ee ugu yar si aad u hesho laba lambar oo buuxiya shuruudda.
n-m-h1-logic-07.material: Lambarrada dabiiciga ah 1 ilaa 60 dhexdooda, ha noqdo A urur jibbaarrada a, B-na urur jibbaarrada b. Tusaale ahaan, haddii a=4, markaas A={4, 8, 12, …, 60}.
n-m-h1-logic-07.thinking.0: Dib u qorista tirada xubnaha ururinta adigoo isticmaalaya tirada xubnaha isgoyska

n-m-h1-logic-07.thinking.2: Helista dhowr xal oo la hubiyo

n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.prompt: Marka a=6 iyo b=15, dooro hadalka sharaxaya si sax ah xubnaha A∩B.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.0: Liis garee dhowr lambar laftaada, laga bilaabo kan ugu yar, kuwaas oo ah jibbaarrada 6 iyo 15 labadaba.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg lambarrada aad heshay oo eeg jibbaarrada lambarka kee ayay sameeyaan.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.a: Waa jibbaarrada 90, sidaas darteed ma jiraan laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.a: Waxay wax-ku-dhigga 6×15 u qaadatay aasaaska jibbaarrada guud. Ma aysan hubin haddii jibbaar guud oo ka yar uu jiro.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.b: Waxay la mid tahay kan yar ee tirada jibbaarrada 6 iyo tirada jibbaarrada 15
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxay u qaadatay kan yar ee labada cabbir ee urur-jibbaarrada sidii cabbirka isgoyska. Ma aysan si toos ah u helin lambarrada is dul dhaca.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.c: Waa jibbaarrada 30, sidaas darteed waxaa jira laba: 30 iyo 60
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.o.d: Waa jibbaarrada 3, sidaas darteed waxaa jira 20
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxay isticmaashay 3, qaybiyaha guud ee 6 iyo 15, sidii aasaas. Noqoshada jibbaar 3 ma ka dhigto lambar jibbaar 6 iyo 15.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s1.explain: Lambarrada jibbaarrada 6 iyo 15 labadaba waa jibbaarrada jibbaarka guud ee ugu yar, 30. Laga bilaabo 1 ilaa 60, waxaa jira laba: 30 iyo 60. Haddii aad u tiriso sidii jibbaarrada 6×15=90, waxaad si khaldan u heshaa ma jiraan.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.prompt: Geli laba lammaane oo kala duwan oo lambarro dabiici ah a, b oo n(A∪B)=12. Shuruudaha: 2≤a<b≤20, a iyo b ma aha coprime, b-na ma aha jibbaar a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.0: a kasta, marka hore hel n(A)=⌊60÷a⌋, ka dibna hubi haddii ku darista cabbirrada labada urur iyo ka jarida is dul dhaca ay siinayso 12.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.hint.1: Hel is dul dhaca adigoo isticmaalaya jibbaarka guud ee ugu yar. Dooro dhowr (a, b) oo suurtagal ah oo samee miis xisaabeed si aad u barbar dhigto.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c1: a iyo b waa lambarro dabiici ah oo 2≤a<b≤20.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Waa inay noqdaan lambarro dabiici ah oo 2≤a<b≤20.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ma aha coprime, b-na ma aha jibbaar a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Waa inaysan noqon coprime, b-na waa inaysan noqon jibbaar a.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.explain: (6, 15): 10+4−2=12, (6, 16): 10+3−1=12, (6, 20): 10+3−1=12, (8, 10): 7+6−1=12. Baaxaddan gudaheeda, afartan lammaane oo keliya ayaa jira. Haddii aad is dul dhaca u tiriso sidii jibbaarrada a×b, markaas (6, 15) wuxuu siinayaa 10+4−0=14, taas oo khalad ah.

n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qor jibbaarrada 6 iyo 15 ilaa 60 oo hel lambarrada ay wadaagaan.
n-m-h1-logic-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Barbar dhig haddii lambarradaas ay ka yar yihiin ama ka weyn yihiin 90.

n-m-h1-logic-08.title: Sidee u go'aaminnaa haddii hadal "dhammaan x" uu run yahay ama been yahay?
n-m-h1-logic-08.goal: Go'aami haddii hadal ku bilaabmaya "dhammaan x" uu run yahay ama been yahay adigoo isticmaalaya hal tusaale lid ku ah ama dood dhan, ma aha dhowr qiime; ku qor beenintiisa si sax ah; oo tixgeli qiyamka xadka.
n-m-h1-logic-08.material:
Hadalka P: "Dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah x, x²−4x+k>0." (k waa joogto) Saddex saaxiib ayaa go'aamiyay haddii P uu run yahay ama been yahay marka k=4, sidan.
- Jiho: Waxaan geliyay x=0, 1, 3, 5 qiyamka oo dhammaantood waxay ka badnaayeen 0, sidaas darteed waa run.
- Seoyeon: x²−4x+4=(x−2)², laba-jibbaarkuna waa ugu yaraan 0, sidaas darteed had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay 0. Waa run.
- Daeun: Haddii aan geliyo x=2, qiimuhu waa 0, kaas oo aan ka weyneyn 0. Waa been.

n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kala saar haddii sababaynta saaxiib kasta "hubisay dhowr qiime" ama "daboolay dhammaan qiyamka."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hel qiimaha ugu yar ee tibaaxda Seoyeon qortay, oo barbar dhig "ka weyn 0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.a: Run: sababtoo ah waxay run ahayd dhammaan dhowr qiime ee aan isku dayay
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.a: Waxay beddeshay "dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah" dhowr qiime oo la hubiyay. Weli qiyamo aan la hubin ayaa hadhay.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.b: Run: laba-jibbaar had iyo jeer waa ugu yaraan 0, sidaas darteed qiimaha tibaaxdu wuu ka weyn yahay 0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.b: Waxay beddeshay "ugu yaraan 0" "ka weyn 0." Waxay seegtay kiiska sinnaanta run tahay.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.c: Been: waxaa jira lambar dhab ah oo tibaaxdu la mid tahay 0, taasoo jebisa "ka weyn 0 dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah"
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.o.d: Lama sheegi karo: waxaa jira lambarro dhab ah oo aan dhammaad lahayn, sidaas darteed suurtagal ma aha in dhammaantood la hubiyo
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.r.d: Waxay u malaysay inaad go'aamin kartid adigoo hubinaya qiyamka mid mid. Waad go'aamin kartaa adigoo isticmaalaya hal tusaale lid ku ah ama qaab-dhismeedka tibaaxda.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s1.explain: Hadal qaabka "dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah x" waa been haddii xitaa hal x (tusaale lid ku ah) uu fashilmo. Marka k=4, tibaaxdu waa (x−2)², x=2-na waa 0, sidaas darteed "ka weyn 0" ma jirto; sidaas darteed P waa been. Habka Jiho waa dhowr qiime oo la hubiyay oo keliya, Seoyeon-na wuxuu isku dhex yaacay "ugu yaraan 0" iyo "ka weyn 0."
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir immisa qiime oo x ayaa u baahan inay fashilmaan si "dhammaan …, …" ay been u noqoto.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi waa maxay beenintii aan-sinnaanta ">", iyo dhinaca kiiska la mid ah 0 ka tago.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.a: Dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah x, x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.a: Waxay ku hay "dhammaan" sida ay tahay, oo waxay sidoo kale u qortay beenintii ">" "<" oo keliya. Labada qaybood waa khalad.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.b: Dhammaan lambarrada dhabta ah x, x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.b: Waxay ku hay "dhammaan" sidii beenintii "dhammaan" oo waxay beddeshay calaamadda aan-sinnaanta kaliya ka dib. Waxay seegtay in hadal been noqdo isla marka xitaa hal kiis fashilmo.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.c: Waxaa jira lambar dhab ah x oo x²−4x+k<0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.r.c: Waxay u qortay beenintii ">" "<" oo keliya. Kiiska qiimuhu yahay 0 way maqan yahay.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.o.d: Waxaa jira lambar dhab ah x oo x²−4x+k≤0
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s2.explain: Beenintii "dhammaan x, A" waa "waxaa jira x oo aan A ahayn." Beenintii ">0" waa "≤0" (ugu badnaan 0), sidaas darteed beenintu waa: waxaa jira lambar dhab ah x oo x²−4x+k≤0. Marka k=4, beenintani waa run x=2, taas oo waafaqsan xukunka ah in P uu been yahay.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.prompt: Qor baaxadda qiyamka k ee P uu run ka yahay, oo sharax hal jumlad sababta k=4 aysan ugu jirin baaxaddaas.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.0: Dib u qor x²−4x+k qaab (x−2)² uu ku muuqdo, oo ku muuji qiimaha ugu yar marka loo eego k.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.hint.1: Barbar dhig shuruudda ">0" si aad u go'aamiso haddii qiimahaas ugu yar uu tahay inuu ka weyn yahay 0 ama ugu yaraan 0.

n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma go'aamisay baaxadda adigoo isticmaalaya xaqiiqda ah in qiimaha ugu yar uu tahay inuu ka weyn yahay 0?

n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.0: x²−4x+k=(x−2)²+k−4 qiimaha ugu yar-na waa k−4, sidaas darteed had iyo jeer wuu ka weyn yahay 0 marka k>4. Haddii k=4, qiimuhu waa 0 marka x=2, sidaas darteed ma ka weyna 0 k=4-na lama daro.
n-m-h1-logic-08.s.s3.model.1: Kala soocida 16−4k waa inay noqotaa taban, sidaas darteed k waa inuu ka weyn yahay 4. Haddii k=4, kala soocidu waa 0, sidaas darteed qiimaha tibaaxdu waa 0 marka x=2, P-na waa been.
